source:
你的打击发出距你300尺内都能听见的雷鸣。被该次攻击检定命中的目标会在此次攻击中额外受到2d6点雷鸣伤害，如果目标是一名生物，则它必须成功于一次力量豁免，否则其被向着远离你的方向推离10尺并陷入倒地状态。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，伤害就提高1d6。
target:
Your strike makes a thunderous sound audible within 300 feet of you. The target hit by this attack roll takes an extra 2d6 Thunder damage from the attack. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and have the Prone condition.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved the audible radius, creature-only save, push and Prone effects, and damage scaling.

source:
你施放出一道雷鸣能量。在以你为源点15尺立方区域内的每名生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者将受到2d8点雷鸣伤害，并被向远离你的方向推离10尺。豁免成功则只受一半伤害。
此外，所有完全位于该区域内且未被固定住的物件都将被推离10尺。该法术还会发出距你300尺内都能听见的雷霆巨响。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，伤害就提高1d8。
target:
You release a wave of thunderous energy. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
In addition, all unsecured objects entirely within the area are pushed 10 feet away. The spell also produces a thunderous boom audible within 300 feet of you.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved both creature and unsecured-object effects and the distinct failure/success results.

source:
该法术创造出一个隐形、无心智、无定形的中型 力场。你可以在法术终止前命令它进行简单的工作。该仆役被创造出来后出现在施法距离内一处未占空间的地面上。其AC为10，具有1点生HP，力量为2，且不能攻击。若仆从的生命值降至 0，则法术终止。
在每个自己回合内以一个附赠动作 ，你可以精神性的对仆役下达一道命令，使其移动至多15尺并与一个物件进行互动。仆役可以做人类能做到的简单工作，例如拿取东西、打扫卫生、修补东西、叠衣服、点火、上菜、倒饮料等。一旦你下达了命令，仆役就会尽全力去进行任务直至完成任务，并在此后等待你的下一个命令。
如果你命令仆役做一件需要它离开你身边60尺的工作，则法术终止。
target:
This spell creates an Invisible, mindless, shapeless Medium force. You can command it to perform simple tasks until the spell ends. The servant appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within range when created. It has AC 10, 1 HP, and a Strength of 2, and it cannot attack. If the servant's Hit Points drop to 0, the spell ends.
As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally give the servant a command to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. The servant can perform simple tasks that a human could do, such as fetching things, cleaning, mending, folding clothes, lighting fires, serving food, and pouring drinks. Once you give a command, the servant does its best to carry out the task until it is complete, then waits for your next command.
If you command the servant to perform a task that requires it to move 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.
note: The source's malformed HP wording is rendered as HP. Its final distance condition says move 60 feet away, without explicitly saying beyond; that wording is retained.

source:
一支缠绕着碎裂魔力的蓝色能量长矛射向施法距离内的一个生物，并在你与目标之间生成一道持久的闪电弧。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到2d12点闪电伤害。
无论首次攻击是否命中，在你接下来的每个回合中，你都可以用附赠动作直接对目标造成1d12点闪电伤害。
此外，如果目标与你之间的距离超出了法术的施法距离，或者目标相对你而言处于全身掩护状态，法术将提前终止。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，此法术的初始伤害就提高1d12。
target:
A lance of blue energy wreathed in crackling magic shoots toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning between you and the target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d12 Lightning damage.
Whether or not the initial attack hits, on each of your subsequent turns you can use a Bonus Action to deal 1d12 Lightning damage to the target automatically.
The spell also ends early if the target is beyond the spell's range from you or has Total Cover from you.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The spell's initial damage increases by 1d12 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved the 2024 initial-hit independence, Bonus Action follow-up, and initial-damage-only scaling. Root wording check: the distance condition does not require the target itself to have moved.

source:
被该次攻击检定命中的目标会在此次攻击中额外受到1d6点暗蚀伤害，并且目标必须通过一次感知豁免检定，否则直到法术结束为止陷入恐慌状态。在自己的每回合结束时，被恐慌的目标可以重复此豁免，成功则结束该法术对自身的影响。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比一环高一环，伤害就提高1d6。
target:
The target hit by this attack roll takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage from the attack and must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, the Frightened target can repeat the save, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved Necrotic damage and end-of-turn repeated saves rather than substituting an older version.

source:
• 一股30尺长，5尺宽的的线状强酸从你的位置向你指定的任意方向喷射而出。在线状区域内的每个生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将在法术持续时间内被强酸覆盖，或直到自己或其他生物用一个动作从其身上刮下或者洗下。被强酸覆盖的生物在每个自己回合开始时受到2d4点强酸伤害。
• 升环法术效应。使用2环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比1环高一环，法术的伤害就增加2d4。
context: column:M;spell:Tasha’s Caustic Brew;book:塔莎的万象坩埚;level:1
target:
• A stream of acid in a Line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide erupts from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is covered in acid for the spell's duration, or until it or another creature uses an action to scrape or wash the acid off. A creature covered in acid takes 2d4 Acid damage at the start of each of its turns.
• At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the spell's damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1.
note: Preserved the action to remove acid, start-of-turn damage, full Line dimensions, and higher-level scaling.

source:
• 此法术捕获了部分袭来的能量，减轻它对你的效果，并将之储存起来以用在你的下一次近战攻击中。在你的下个回合的开始之前，你对于触发法术的伤害类型具有抗性。此外，在你的下个回合，第一次以近战攻击命中时，目标额外受到1d6点触发法术的伤害类型的伤害，同时此法术终结。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每高一环，额外伤害便增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Absorb Elements;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:1
target:
• The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack. Until the start of your next turn, you have Resistance to the damage type that triggered the spell. In addition, the first time you hit with a melee attack on your next turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the triggering type, and the spell ends.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the extra damage increases by 1d6 for each higher slot level.
note: Preserved the next-turn-only melee trigger and the source's scaling wording.

source: • 你和一个你接触的，对你友好或被你魅惑的野兽建立起一道心灵链接。若该野兽的智力不低于4，则此法术失败。直到法术终结，只要你和该野兽相互处于彼此的视觉线内，此链接便处于活动状态。通过此链接，该野兽可以理解你以心灵感应传递的信息，而其也会以心灵感应向你传递其基本的情绪和意愿。只要此链接处于激活状态，该野兽在对你周围5尺，你能看见的任何生物所进行的攻击检定中获得优势。
context: column:M;spell:Beast Bond;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:1
target: • You establish a telepathic link with a Beast you touch that is friendly to you or Charmed by you. The spell fails if the Beast has an Intelligence of 4 or higher. Until the spell ends, the link is active while you and the Beast are within one another's line of sight. Through the link, the Beast can understand your telepathic messages, and it can telepathically communicate its basic emotions and intentions to you. While the link is active, the Beast has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that you can see.
note: Preserved the Intelligence cutoff, mutual line-of-sight condition, and the caster's visibility requirement for Advantage.

source:
• 选择距离之内，一个未被穿戴或持握的，重量为1到5磅的物体。此目标在你选择的一个方向上以直线轨迹飞行，在落到地面前至多行进90尺，若其在此过程中撞击到了固体表面则会提前停止运动。若该物体将会撞击一个生物，该生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免检定，豁免失败该物体击中该生物并不再移动。目标被击中后，它与该物体各受到3d8点钝击伤害。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每高一环，你可以指定的物体的重量上限便增加5磅，而造成的伤害便提高1d8。
target:
• Choose an object within range that weighs 1 to 5 pounds and is neither worn nor held. The object flies in a straight line in a direction you choose, traveling up to 90 feet before falling to the ground. It stops early if it strikes a solid surface. If the object would strike a creature, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the object hits the creature and stops moving. When the target is hit, it and the object each take 3d8 Bludgeoning damage.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the maximum weight of the object you can target increases by 5 pounds and the damage increases by 1d8 for each higher slot level.
note: Preserved object eligibility, collision handling, damage to both object and creature, and weight/damage scaling.

source:
• 你唤醒了一个处于距离内、你能看见的生物内心的凡性。此法术对于构装生物或不死生物无效。目标必须通过一次感知豁免检定，否则在持续时间内陷入恐慌状态。被恐惧的生物可以在它的每个回合结束时重复进行这个豁免检定，若成功将结束法术对自身的效果。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每高一环，你就可以多指定一个额外生物作为目标。每个被你指定的生物相互之间的距离必须在30尺内。
context: column:M;spell:Cause Fear;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:1
target:
• You awaken a sense of mortality in a creature you can see within range. This spell has no effect on Constructs or Undead. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for the duration. The Frightened creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, you can target one additional creature for each higher slot level. Each creature you target must be within 30 feet of every other target.
note: Preserved type exclusions and the pairwise distance requirement for additional targets.

source:
• 你进行几种宗教典礼之一。当你施展此法术时，选择下述典礼之一，其目标必须在施法过程中处于你周围10尺内。
• 赎罪Atonement：你接触一个阵营发生了改变的自愿生物，而你进行一次DC20的感知（洞悉）检定。成功则你令目标恢复其原始阵营。
• 祝福圣水Bless Water：你接触一瓶水并将它转变为圣水。
• 成人礼Coming of Age：你接触一个年龄足够成年的类人生物。在接下来的24小时内，当目标进行一次属性检定时，它可以投d4并将投出的结果加到属性检定上。一个生物只能从此仪式中获得此增益一次。
• 献身Dedication：你接触一个自愿转变为你的宗教的信仰或想要为你信奉的神明服务的类人生物。在接下来的24小时内，当目标进行一次豁免检定时，它可以投d4并将投出的结果加到检定上。一个生物只能从此仪式中获得此增益一次。
• 葬礼Funeral Rite：你祝福一具处于你周围5尺内的尸体。在接下来的7天内，目标不能被任何弱于祈愿术wish的方式变为不死生物。
• 婚礼Wedding：你接触自愿接受婚姻的束缚的成年类人生物。在接下来的7天内，每个目标若处于彼此30尺范围内，则在AC上获得+2加值。一个生物只有在丧偶时才能再次从这个仪式中受益。
target:
• You perform one of several religious ceremonies. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following ceremonies. Its targets must remain within 10 feet of you throughout the casting.
• Atonement: You touch a willing creature whose alignment has changed and make a DC 20 Wisdom (Insight) check. On a success, you restore the target's original alignment.
• Bless Water: You touch a flask of water and transform it into holy water.
• Coming of Age: You touch a Humanoid who is old enough to be an adult. For the next 24 hours, whenever the target makes an ability check, it can roll a d4 and add the result to the check. A creature can gain this benefit from this ceremony only once.
• Dedication: You touch a Humanoid willing to convert to your religion or to serve a deity you worship. For the next 24 hours, whenever the target makes a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the result to the roll. A creature can gain this benefit from this ceremony only once.
• Funeral Rite: You bless a corpse within 5 feet of you. For the next 7 days, the target cannot be turned into an Undead by any means short of the Wish spell.
• Wedding: You touch adult Humanoids willing to enter into marriage. For the next 7 days, each target gains a +2 bonus to AC while within 30 feet of the others. A creature can benefit from this ceremony again only if widowed.
note: All six ceremonies, their eligibility limits, durations, bonuses, and once-only or widowhood restrictions are retained.

source:
• 你向着距离内的一个生物掷出一团变化不定、高声尖鸣的混乱能量。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。击中时，目标受到2d8+1d6点伤害。选择一颗d8投出的数字来决定它的伤害类型：1强酸，2冷冻，3火焰，4力场，5闪电，6毒素，7精神，8雷鸣。
• 若你的两颗d8投出了相同的数字，混乱能量将从目标跳跃到一个由你选择的、处于它周围30尺内的其他生物上。对新目标进行一次新的攻击检定，进行新的伤害检定，这次伤害检定也可能令混沌能量跳跃。
• 一个生物只能被此混乱箭选作目标一次。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施展此法术时，每个生物受到额外伤害，类型与投出的一致。额外伤害等于高于1环的每个等级1d6点。
context: column:M;spell:Chaos Bolt;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:1
target:
• You hurl a mass of shifting, shrieking, chaotic energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8+1d6 damage. Choose the number rolled on one of the d8s to determine the damage type: 1 Acid, 2 Cold, 3 Fire, 4 Force, 5 Lightning, 6 Poison, 7 Psychic, or 8 Thunder.
• If both d8s show the same number, the chaotic energy leaps from the target to another creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. Make a new attack roll against the new target and a new damage roll, which can cause the chaotic energy to leap again.
• A creature can be targeted by this Chaos Bolt only once.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, each creature takes extra damage of the type rolled. The extra damage equals 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
note: Preserved all eight damage mappings, repeat jumps, once-per-creature targeting, and scaling on each creature.

source:
• 你在施法距离内引发地面颤动。处于该区域，除你之外的其他生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免检定。若检定失败，该生物受到1d6点钝击伤害并应击倒地。若区域的地表为松软的土壤或石头，其在被清理之前成为困难地形。每5尺直径的部分都需要至少1分钟来手动清理。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每高一环，伤害便增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Earth Tremor;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:1
target:
• You cause the ground within range to tremble. Each creature other than you in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. If the ground in the area is loose earth or stone, it becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared. Clearing each portion with a diameter of 5 feet by hand takes at least 1 minute.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each higher slot level.
note: The source explicitly describes each cleared portion by diameter, not as a square; retained.

source:
• 当你施展此法术时，用线绳在一处处于你触及内的地面或地板上创造一个5尺半径的圆圈。当你完成施法时，线绳消失，化为一个魔法陷阱。
• 陷阱几乎是隐形的，要找到它需要一次成功的对抗你的法术豁免DC的智力（调查）检定。
• 当一个小型、中型或大型的生物移动进入受到此法术保护的区域时，陷阱就会触发。触发的生物必须通过一次敏捷豁免检定否则摔倒、应击倒地，并被魔法性地上下颠倒的举到半空中，直到它距离被保护的地面或地板3尺高。生物被束缚在那里直到法术结束。
• 被束缚的生物可以在其每个回合的结束时进行一次敏捷豁免检定，成功则结束被束缚。或者，其他能触及被束缚的生物可以进行一次智力（奥秘）检定，对抗你的法术豁免DC。成功则束缚的效果也会结束。
• 在陷阱被触发之后，当没有生物被它束缚时，法术将会结束。
target:
• When you cast this spell, you use cord to create a circle with a radius of 5 feet on the ground or floor within your reach. When you finish casting, the cord disappears and becomes a magical trap.
• The trap is nearly Invisible. Finding it requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
• The trap triggers when a Small, Medium, or Large creature moves into the area protected by the spell. The triggering creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall, become Prone, and be magically hoisted upside down until it hangs 3 feet above the protected ground or floor. The creature is Restrained there until the spell ends.
• The Restrained creature can make a Dexterity saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the restraint on a success. Alternatively, another creature that can reach the Restrained creature can make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC. A success also ends the restraint.
• After the trap is triggered, the spell ends when no creature is Restrained by it.
note: The source explicitly adds falling and Prone before upside-down suspension; these are retained rather than corrected from another rules text.

source:
• 你行动如风。在持续时间内，你的移动不会导致借机攻击。
• 此外，在此法术结束前仅一次，你可以在自己的回合让自己的一次武器攻击检定获得优势。这次攻击若击中会造成额外1d8力场伤害。无论你是否击中，你的步行速度都会增加30尺，直到这个回合结束。
context: column:M;spell:Zephyr Strike;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:1
target:
• You move like the wind. For the duration, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
• In addition, once before this spell ends, you can give yourself Advantage on one weapon attack roll on your turn. On a hit, that attack deals an extra 1d8 Force damage. Whether you hit or miss, your walking speed increases by 30 feet until the end of that turn.
note: Preserved the single-use attack benefit and speed increase on either a hit or a miss.

source:
• 当你试图卖掉从混沌神殿中解放出来的那座奇异章鱼雕像时，你是否需要从那个无良商人口袋里再压榨几块黄金？当收税员驻足你的身前时，你是否需要贬低一些魔法资产的价值呢？扭曲价值法术为你保驾护航。
• 你施展此法术于边长不超过1尺的一个物件上，以幻术的滋养和抛光来加倍它看起来的价值，或者是用虚幻的划痕、凹陷和其他不雅的特征来减半它看起来的价值。任何检查物件的人，可以通过智力（调查）检定对抗你的法术DC，若成功将会确定它的真实价值。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施展该法术时，使用的法术位每比1环高一环，目标物件的最大尺寸就可以增加1尺。
context: column:M;spell:Distort Value;book:艾奎兹玄有限责任公司;level:1
target:
• Need to squeeze a few more gold pieces out of an unscrupulous merchant when selling that strange octopus statue you liberated from the temple of chaos? Need to understate the value of some magical assets when the tax collector stops in front of you? Distort Value has you covered.
• You cast this spell on an object no more than 1 foot on a side. Illusory embellishment and polish double its apparent value, or illusory scratches, dents, and other unsightly features halve its apparent value. Anyone examining the object can determine its true value with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell DC.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the object's maximum dimensions can increase by 1 foot for each slot level above 1.
note: Preserved the complete introductory examples, apparent-value alternatives, inspection check, and size scaling.

source:
• 每一个法师学徒都会施展无聊的古董魔法飞弹。啊哈，它总是击中目标。（哈欠）。别再干你祖父流传下来的苦差事了，来像吉姆• 达克马奇那样，用这个改进版本的法术吧！
• 你创造了三个扭曲着的，尖啸着的，低过敏的，无麸质的魔法立场飞镖。每一枚飞弹都瞄准一个在施法距离内由你选择的可见生物。为每一枚飞弹进行远程攻击检定。若命中，飞弹将对这个目标造成2d4点力场伤害。
• 如果这次攻击检定形成了一次重击，取代了正常重击形成的两次伤害骰，那枚飞弹的目标将受到5d4力场伤害。但是如果任何一个飞弹的攻击检定为1，所有飞弹都会丢失他们的目标并且在你的脸上爆炸。那时每一枚飞弹都会对你造成1点伤害。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用2环或更高的法术位施展该法术时，使用的法术位每比1环高一环，法术就可以多创造一枚飞镖，但是版权成分也会增加1gp。
context: column:M;spell:Jim's Magic Missile;book:艾奎兹玄有限责任公司;level:1
target:
• Every apprentice wizard can cast that boring old relic, Magic Missile. Oh yes, it always hits. (Yawn.) Stop doing the drudgework handed down by your grandfather and use this improved version of the spell, just like Jim Darkmagic!
• You create three twisting, shrieking, hypoallergenic, gluten-free darts of magical force. Each missile targets a creature you can see of your choice within range. Make a ranged attack roll for each missile. On a hit, a missile deals 2d4 Force damage to its target.
• If an attack roll scores a Critical Hit, that missile's target takes 5d4 Force damage instead of the normal doubled damage dice for a Critical Hit. However, if any missile's attack roll is a 1, all the missiles miss their targets and explode in your face. Each missile then deals 1 damage to you.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the spell creates one additional dart for each slot level above 1, but the royalty component also increases by 1 gp.
note: Preserved the promotional prose, ranged attack wording, special critical damage, all-miss backlash, and royalty increase. The source does not explicitly call the rolls spell attacks or assign the self-damage a type.

source:
• 你魔法地让触发生物分心，将其短暂的迟疑转变为另一个生物的鼓励。触发生物必须重新投掷d20并选用较低的结果。
• 之后你能选择施法距离内的一个不同生物（可以是你自己）。选择的生物在接下来的一分钟里的第一次攻击检定、属性检定或豁免检定中具有优势。一个生物在同一时间里只会拥有一次来自该法术的增益。
context: column:M;spell:Silvery Barbs;book:斯翠海文：混乱之课;level:1
target:
• You magically distract the triggering creature, turning its momentary hesitation into encouragement for another creature. The triggering creature must reroll the d20 and use the lower result.
• You can then choose a different creature within range, which can be yourself. The chosen creature has Advantage on the first attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes within the next minute. A creature can have only one benefit from this spell at a time.
note: Preserved the lower-result reroll and the different-creature requirement, including self-selection.

source:
• 施法距离内你可见的一点的10尺半径球形范围内的重力暂时性地增加了。
• 在你施法时，所有处于该范围内的生物必须通过一个体质豁免。若豁免失败，该生物受到2d8点力场伤害且其移动速度在他的下个回合结束前减半。若豁免成功，该生物受到一半的伤害且在移动速度上没有减值。
• 直到你的下个回合开始，任何想要把该范围内未被着装或携带的物品移动或捡起都需要进行一次对抗你的法术豁免DC的成功的力量检定，若成功才可行。
• 升环施法效应：每当你使用2环或更高的法术位施展该法术时，每比1环多一的法术位能使该法术的伤害增加1d8。
target:
• Gravity temporarily increases in a Sphere with a radius of 10 feet centered on a point you can see within range.
• When you cast the spell, each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 Force damage and its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and suffers no reduction to its Speed.
• Until the start of your next turn, moving or picking up an object in the area that is neither worn nor carried requires a successful Strength check against your spell save DC.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.
note: Preserved the different timing of the movement penalty and object-manipulation restriction.

source: 拉莱耶是一座笼罩于恐惧之迷雾中的古老城市。你利用那恐惧迷雾，以施法距离内一点为中心创造一片半径20尺的球状迷雾。该球状区域内处于轻度遮蔽。在其中可以看见一些诡异而转瞬即逝的模糊影像。在该球状区域内结束其回合的生物受到1d4心灵伤害。智力为3或更低的野兽会主动拒绝进入这片球状区域。
context: column:M;spell:Create Mist of R'lyeh;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:1
target: R'lyeh is an ancient city shrouded in a mist of dread. You draw on that dreadful mist to create a Sphere of fog with a radius of 20 feet centered on a point within range. The Sphere is Lightly Obscured, and strange, fleeting, indistinct images can be seen within it. A creature that ends its turn in the Sphere takes 1d4 Psychic damage. Beasts with an Intelligence of 3 or lower actively refuse to enter the Sphere.
note: Preserved Lightly Obscured rather than substituting heavier fog, end-of-turn damage, and the Beast Intelligence threshold.

source:
你释放出一股旋转的暗影浪潮，笼罩你身周的区域。你施展该法术时，位于源自你的10尺立方区域的黑暗内的每名生物进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败则受到2d8心灵伤害，并陷入目盲直至其不在位于该黑暗区域。豁免成功则其仅受半伤且不会陷入目盲。黑暗持续至你的下个回合结束。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高一环，立方区域的边长就增加5尺。
context: column:M;spell:Tide of Darkness;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:1
target:
You release a swirling tide of shadow that envelops the area around you. When you cast the spell, each creature in the darkness of a 10-foot Cube originating from you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d8 Psychic damage and is Blinded until it is no longer in that area of darkness. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is not Blinded. The darkness lasts until the end of your next turn.
At Higher Levels. The Cube's side length increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved the casting-time save, location-dependent blindness, next-turn darkness end, and area-only scaling.

source:
你创造出一条窃取生命的幽影长须，猛然抽向施法距离内一个你可见的生物。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，目标将受到2d8暗蚀伤害，而你则获得等同于所造成伤害的临时生命值。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高一环，伤害便增加1d8。
context: column:M;spell:Umbral Tendril;book:火炬光下的克苏鲁;level:1
target:
You create a long, life-stealing tendril of shadow that lashes at a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Necrotic damage, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt.
At Higher Levels. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved Temporary Hit Points equal to actual damage dealt, not healing or a separate roll.

source:
你创造一个由强酸凝胶组成的球体，并将其掷向范围内的一个生物。发动一次远程法术攻击。攻击命中时，该生物将受到 2d6点强酸伤害。无论攻击命中还是失手，球体都会爆炸，目标及其5尺范围内的生物需要成功通过一次敏捷豁免，失败则受到2d6点强酸伤害。
升环施法效应：使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，法术的伤害就增加 1d6。
target:
You create an orb of acidic gel and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the creature takes 2d6 Acid damage. Whether the attack hits or misses, the orb explodes. The target and creatures within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 Acid damage.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, the spell's damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above level one.
note: The explosion includes the target even on a missed attack. The source says the spell's damage increases without distinguishing impact from explosion; that ambiguity is retained.

source:
选择范围内你能看见的一个生物，使其遭受一种魔法毒素的攻击。目标受到2d4点毒素伤害，并必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则目标在法术持续时间内中毒。
以这种方式中毒的生物，必须在它的每个回合结束时进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败则承受2d4点毒素伤害。若豁免检定成功，则法术在目标身上终止。
法术次级复原术Lesser Restoration可以提前结束目标身上的此法术。
升环施法效应：使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，你便可以额外选择一个生物作为目标。
target:
Choose a creature you can see within range and subject it to a magical toxin. The target takes 2d4 Poison damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is Poisoned for the spell's duration.
A creature Poisoned in this way must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes 2d4 Poison damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on the target.
The Lesser Restoration spell can end this spell on the target early.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserved automatic initial damage, failed-repeat-save damage, Lesser Restoration removal, and target-only scaling.

source:
你使范围内你能看见的一个生物感染一种魔法疾病。在目标的每个回合开始，它必须进行一次体质豁免。若豁免检定失败则目标需承受1d12点黯蚀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。如果目标成功通过3次豁免，则法术终止。
法术次级复原术Lesser Restoration可以提前结束目标身上的此法术。
升环施法效应：使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高两环，法术的伤害就额外提升1d12。
target:
You infect a creature you can see within range with a magical disease. At the start of each of the target's turns, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d12 Necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The spell ends if the target succeeds on 3 saves.
The Lesser Restoration spell can end this spell on the target early.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, the spell's damage increases by 1d12 for every two slot levels above level one.
note: Preserved three successful saves without adding a consecutive requirement and the two-slot-level scaling interval.

source:
在法术持续时间内，你的舌头变成一根由绿色死灵能量组成的又细又长的绳子，你可以用它汲取其他生物的活力。60尺范围内你所选的一个你能看到的生物需要通过一次体质豁免。若豁免失败，则目标积累一层力竭，而你恢复1d4+你施法关键属性调整值的生命值。
在法术持续时间结束前的每个回合，你都可以用你的动作使相同或不同的一个生物变成目标。但是若一个生物成功通过了对抗肺痨湍流法术的体质豁免，则你不能再使其成为目标。
target:
For the spell's duration, your tongue becomes a long, thin cord of green necromantic energy that you can use to drain other creatures' vitality. One creature you choose that you can see within 60 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains one level of Exhaustion, and you regain Hit Points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
On each turn before the spell's duration ends, you can use your action to target the same creature or a different one. However, if a creature succeeds on its Constitution saving throw against Stream of Consumption, you cannot target it again.
note: Preserved Exhaustion, caster healing, repeated action targeting, and immunity to retargeting after a successful save.

source:
在法术持续时间内，你获得毒素伤害的抗性并在对抗中毒的豁免检定中获得优势。除此之外，当一个生物在你5尺范围内以近战攻击命中你时，护盾会向他们喷出毒素，对攻击者造成1d8点毒素伤害。
升环施法效应：使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高两环，法术的伤害就额外提升1d8。
target:
For the spell's duration, you have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws against being Poisoned. In addition, when a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield sprays poison at it, dealing 1d8 Poison damage to the attacker.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, the spell's damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above level one.
note: Preserved separate Poison damage Resistance and condition-save Advantage, melee retaliation range, and two-level scaling interval.

source:
你在攻击命中的瞬间将其加快或减缓，从而增加或减少其动能（见下方选项）。
增能Accelerate。 目标受到该攻击造成的额外2d6伤害，伤害类型与触发攻击造成的伤害类型相同。
缓能Decelerate。 目标受到的伤害减少2d6（最低降为0）。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高一环，额外的伤害或减少的伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You speed up or slow down an attack at the instant it hits, increasing or decreasing its kinetic energy as described in the options below.
Accelerate. The target takes an extra 2d6 damage from the attack, of the same type as the triggering attack's damage.
Decelerate. The damage the target takes is reduced by 2d6, to a minimum of 0.
At Higher Levels. The extra damage or damage reduction increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved both mutually described options, matching damage type, zero floor, and scaling of either option.

source:
选择以下伤害类型之一：强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电、毒素、雷鸣。此次攻击命中的目标额外受到2d6所选类型的伤害。你可以选择让触发攻击造成的伤害也改为所选伤害类型，或者维持原先的伤害类型。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高1环，额外伤害就增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Ballistic Smite;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:1
target:
Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. The target hit by this attack takes an extra 2d6 damage of the chosen type. You can also change the triggering attack's damage to the chosen type, or keep its original damage type.
At Higher Levels. The extra damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level 1.
note: Preserved all six types and the optional conversion of the triggering attack's own damage. The source expresses the scaling interval as the numeral 1.

source: 当你施展此法术时，源自你的30尺光环区域内所有脚印和指纹都会在法术持续时间内变得高亮并微微发光。当你施展此法术时，选择过去10天内的任意时间点，只有该时间点至现在的脚印和指纹会被高亮。每个留下脚印和指纹的生物会被分配一种独特的颜色，但除此以外不会有其他识别。任何在此光环区域内移动或触碰物件的生物也会留下彩色的脚印和指纹，这可能会揭示该区域内的隐形生物。
target: When you cast this spell, all footprints and fingerprints in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you become highlighted and glow faintly for the duration. Choose any point in time within the past 10 days when you cast the spell. Only footprints and fingerprints left from that time until now are highlighted. Each creature that left prints is assigned a unique color, but is otherwise unidentified. Any creature that moves or touches objects within the Emanation also leaves colored footprints and fingerprints, potentially revealing Invisible creatures in the area.
note: Preserved the selectable historical cutoff, color-only identification, and new prints from moving or touching objects.

source:
你在地面上咒唤出一道低矮的圆石墙壁。矮墙厚18寸，由三个5尺长3尺高的墙段组成。每个墙段都必须与至少一个别的墙段有所连接。
躲在矮墙后的中型生物具有半身掩护；躲在矮墙后的小型生物具有四分之三掩护。这堵矮墙可以被翻越过去，且不需要额外消耗移动力。
每个墙段具有10的AC与30生命值，其会在生命值被降至0时坍塌，并被摧毁。当所有墙段都被摧毁时，或是法术结束时，这堵矮墙将消失。
context: column:M;spell:Conjure Cover;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:1
target:
You conjure a low wall of rounded stones on the ground. The wall is 18 cun thick and consists of three sections, each 5 feet long and 3 feet high. Each section must connect to at least one other section.
A Medium creature behind the wall has Half Cover; a Small creature behind it has Three-Quarters Cover. The wall can be climbed over without spending extra movement.
Each section has AC 10 and 30 Hit Points. It collapses and is destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. The wall disappears when all its sections are destroyed or when the spell ends.
note: The source uses the unqualified unit cun for thickness; it is preserved as cun pending unit verification rather than silently converted to inches. All other dimensions, cover rules, and section statistics are retained.

source:
命中时或失手时，那枚弹药（或武器本身）化为一束5尺宽的线状魔法能量，自你延展至武器的常规范围为止。此线状区域需包括此次攻击的原目标，线状区域内的所有生物都需要通过一次敏捷豁免检定，豁免失败将受到武器的正常伤害，豁免成功将受到一半伤害。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高1环，武器的伤害就增加1d8。
context: column:M;spell:Perforating Shot;book:瓦尔达的秘密尖塔;level:1
target:
Whether the attack hits or misses, the ammunition, or the weapon itself, becomes a Line of magical energy 5 feet wide, extending from you to the weapon's normal range. The Line must include the attack's original target. Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking the weapon's normal damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels. The weapon's damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level 1.
note: Preserved the original-target inclusion, normal-range endpoint, hit-or-miss activation, and source's numeral 1 scaling interval.

source: 你魔法性地在源自你的100尺的光环区域内散播一个不超过10个单词的流言。区域内任何能听到并能理解至少三个其他生物的生物，都会相信他们听到附近有人在重复这个流言。不同的生物从不同的人那里听到流言，因此无法辨别具体的来源。通常，即使听到最恶毒的流言，生物也不会因此变得敌对，但听到流言会对其态度产生积极或消极的影响。
target: You magically spread a rumor of no more than 10 words in a 100-foot Emanation originating from you. Any creature in the area that can hear and understand at least three other creatures believes it heard someone nearby repeat the rumor. Different creatures hear the rumor from different people, making a specific source impossible to identify. Creatures generally do not become hostile merely from hearing even the nastiest rumor, but hearing it can affect their attitudes positively or negatively.
note: Preserved the unusual requirement to hear and understand at least three other creatures, the word limit, and the qualified attitude effect.

source:
在施法距离内你能看到的一处空地上物质化出至多五件简易或军用武器。这些武器都是非魔法的，但它们制作精良且可以按照你的喜好定制其风格样式。法术结束时这些武器会消失。
升环施法。使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比一环高一环，你可以额外召唤三件简易或军用武器。
target:
Up to five Simple or Martial weapons materialize in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The weapons are nonmagical, but they are finely crafted and can have a style and appearance of your choosing. They disappear when the spell ends.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, you can summon three additional Simple or Martial weapons for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserved the five-weapon base, nonmagical nature, cosmetic customization, and three-weapon scaling without replacing this source with another edition.

source:
你在任何重量不超过500磅的固体、颗粒或液体周围吹出一个气泡，使其悬浮离地面4尺。无论气泡内装有什么，气泡的重量都是10磅，且可以用一个动作推动气泡。强风或能推动生物的效应也会推动气泡。气泡始终漂浮在离地至少4尺的高度，从高处下落时以每轮10尺的速度下降。
生物可以用一个动作刺破气泡的外表面，使其爆裂并释放其内容物。
升环施法。使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每比一环高一环，气泡可以承载的重量增加500磅。
target:
You blow a bubble around any solid, granular material, or liquid weighing no more than 500 pounds, causing it to levitate 4 feet above the ground. Regardless of its contents, the bubble weighs 10 pounds and can be pushed with an action. Strong winds or effects that push creatures also push the bubble. The bubble always floats at least 4 feet above the ground and descends at a rate of 10 feet per round when falling from a height.
A creature can use an action to puncture the bubble's outer surface, bursting it and releasing its contents.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, the bubble's carrying capacity increases by 500 pounds for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserved the material categories, fixed bubble weight, push and burst actions, minimum height, descent rate, and capacity scaling.

source:
你可以创造出施法距离内一个你能看见的、重量不超过25磅的物体的完全复制品。乍看之下，这两个物体难以区分，且复制品可以如同原物一般发挥功能，但不具有原物可能具有的任何魔法属性。当法术结束时，复制品消失。
如果有生物使用动作检查复制品，该生物可以通过一次对抗你法术豁免DC的智力（调查）检定来判断出这是一个复制品。
升环施法。使用二环或三环法术位施展该法术时，法术持续时间增加至8小时。使用四环或更高法术位时，法术持续时间增加至24小时。
target:
You create an exact duplicate of an object you can see within range that weighs no more than 25 pounds. At first glance, the two objects are difficult to distinguish. The duplicate functions like the original but has none of the original's magical properties, if any. The duplicate disappears when the spell ends.
A creature that uses an action to examine the duplicate can identify it as a copy with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or three, the duration increases to 8 hours. Using a slot of level four or higher increases the duration to 24 hours.
note: Preserved functional copying without magical properties, the inspection action/check, and both duration thresholds.

source:
你在施法距离内一处你能看见的未被占据空间中，从地面创造出一个具有类人特征的小型活化灌木。这灌木拥有木质的身体和面部，但没有手臂，且无法移动。
任何对你怀有敌意的生物在其回合内首次移动到灌木10尺范围内，或在该范围内开始其回合时，都会成为灌木叶片攻击的目标。灌木使用你的法术攻击调整值进行一次远程武器攻击。命中时，该生物受到1d4点挥砍伤害。
在你的回合中，你可以使用一个附赠动作让灌木对其10尺范围内的一个生物进行叶片攻击。如果有多个由你创造的灌木都在目标10尺范围内，则此次攻击命中时每个灌木都会造成1d4点挥砍伤害。
升环施法。使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，每高出一环法术位可以额外创造一个灌木。
target:
You create a Small animated shrub with humanoid features from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The shrub has a wooden body and face, but no arms, and it cannot move.
Any creature hostile to you that moves within 10 feet of the shrub for the first time on its turn, or starts its turn within that distance, becomes the target of the shrub's leaf attack. The shrub makes a ranged weapon attack using your spell attack modifier. On a hit, the creature takes 1d4 Slashing damage.
On your turn, you can use a Bonus Action to have the shrub make a leaf attack against a creature within 10 feet of it. If multiple shrubs you created are within 10 feet of the target, each shrub deals 1d4 Slashing damage when this attack hits.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, you can create one additional shrub for each higher slot level.
note: Preserved the source's ranged weapon attack using a spell attack modifier and its shared-hit wording for multiple shrubs; no separate attack rolls were added.

source:
你尝试镇静施法距离内一个你能看见的类人生物。目标必须进行一次感知豁免。如果豁免失败，则该生物被你镇静直到法术结束。被镇静的生物无法发动攻击，无法施放影响敌人的法术，也无法对其他生物造成伤害。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重复进行豁免检定，豁免成功则效应终止。
升环施法。使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，就可以额外影响一个类人生物。当你选择目标时，这些类人生物之间的距离必须在30尺以内。
target:
You attempt to pacify a Humanoid you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pacified by you until the spell ends. A pacified creature cannot make attacks, cast spells that affect enemies, or deal damage to other creatures. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, you can affect one additional Humanoid for each slot level above level one. The Humanoids must be within 30 feet of one another when you choose them.
note: Preserved pacification as the source's described effect without substituting the Charmed condition.

source:
一面高5尺、宽5尺、厚1尺的沙墙从地面升起，出现在施法距离内你能看到的一处未被占据的空间内。当处于墙体形态时，这些沙子的坚固程度等同于实心石头。这面墙的AC为13且具有10点生命值。将墙体生命值降至0会摧毁它，且根据DM裁定可能导致相连的墙体坍塌。你可以用一个动作提前终止该法术。当法术结束时，墙体会崩塌回归沙砾。
如果你以仪式形式施展此法术，墙体会持续存在直到被摧毁或解消。
target:
A wall of sand 5 feet high, 5 feet wide, and 1 foot thick rises from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range. While in wall form, the sand is as firm as solid stone. The wall has AC 13 and 10 Hit Points. Reducing it to 0 Hit Points destroys it and might cause connected walls to collapse, at the DM's discretion. You can use an action to end the spell early. When the spell ends, the wall collapses back into sand.
If you cast this spell as a Ritual, the wall lasts until destroyed or dispelled.
note: Preserved every dimension, wall statistics, DM discretion for linked collapse, and indefinite Ritual duration.

source:
你迅速长出茂密的叶状植被覆盖全身。施展此法术时，你可以选择植被是否具有其他特征，比如花朵或浆果。
当你处于倒地且静止不动状态时，你与普通的灌木难以分辨。如果某个生物未曾观察到你移动或行动，它必须通过一次对抗你法术豁免DC的智力（调查）检定才能判断出你不是一株灌木。若要在被某个生物识破真身后重新伪装，你必须在该生物看不见你的情况下采取躲藏动作。
在法术持续时间内，你可以使用动作制造并投掷松果、浆果或花苞。当你这样做时，对30尺内的一个生物进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，目标受到1d6+你的施法关键属性调整值的钝击伤害。
target:
You rapidly grow dense, leafy vegetation over your whole body. When you cast the spell, you can choose whether the foliage has other features, such as flowers or berries.
While you are Prone and motionless, you are difficult to distinguish from an ordinary shrub. A creature that has not seen you move or act must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to determine that you are not a shrub. To disguise yourself again after a creature has seen through you, you must take the Hide action while that creature cannot see you.
For the spell's duration, you can use an action to create and throw a pinecone, berry, or flower bud. When you do so, make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 feet. On a hit, the target takes Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
note: Preserved Prone plus immobility, observer-specific redisguise conditions, and the separate action attack.

source:
你在身边5尺范围内一处未被占据的空间召唤出一辆自行车或载具机械。该载具不能大于一个5尺边长的立方体，且只能搭载一个中型或更小的生物。载具具有60尺的步行速度，只要你有至少一只空闲的手操控载具，就可以骑乘并使用这个载具。
你可以使用一个动作提前终止该法术。当法术结束时，载具会消失。
target:
You summon a bicycle or mechanical vehicle in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. The vehicle can be no larger than a Cube with a side length of 5 feet and can carry only one Medium or smaller creature. It has a walking speed of 60 feet. You can ride and use it while you have at least one hand free to operate it.
You can use an action to end the spell early. The vehicle disappears when the spell ends.
note: Preserved capacity, maximum size, free-hand operation, walking speed, and early dismissal action.

source:
当触发法术未能影响你时，你咬住残留在空气中的魔法丝线，吞下这些已经安定的魔力，并获得以下效果之一（由你选择）：
你恢复等同于1d4 + 你的施法关键属性调整值的生命值。
直到你的下回合结束前，你的速度增加15尺。
在你的下回合结束前，你可以投掷一次d4，并将所得数值加到一次你选择的属性检定上。
target:
When the triggering spell fails to affect you, you bite into the magical threads left in the air, swallow the settled magic, and gain one of the following effects of your choice:
You regain Hit Points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
Your Speed increases by 15 feet until the end of your next turn.
Before the end of your next turn, you can roll a d4 once and add the result to one ability check of your choice.
note: Preserved all three alternatives and the single-use ability-check bonus; no additional trigger conditions were supplied.

source:
你在手中或口中创造出一个快速旋转的漩涡水球，然后将其掷向施法距离内的一个生物。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到钝击伤害，具体伤害取决于其与你之间的距离。
1-10尺。5d6
11-60尺。4d6
61-90尺。3d6
升环施法。使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，法术的伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You create a rapidly spinning sphere of swirling water in your hand or mouth and hurl it at a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes Bludgeoning damage based on its distance from you.
1–10 feet: 5d6
11–60 feet: 4d6
61–90 feet: 3d6
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, the spell's damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserved all three distance bands and damage dice. The source gives no band for a distance below 1 foot; none was invented.

source:
你在施法距离内指定至多三件你能看见的武器，使其被水流包裹。投掷一颗d4；在法术持续时间内，这些被选中武器造成的任何伤害都会减少等同于你投掷结果的数值（最低减至1点）。
升环施法。使用二环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，就可以额外指定两件武器。
target:
You choose up to three weapons you can see within range and envelop them in flowing water. Roll a d4. For the spell's duration, any damage dealt by the chosen weapons is reduced by the number rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, you can target two additional weapons for each slot level above level one.
note: Preserved one shared d4 roll, the minimum of 1 damage, and two additional weapons per higher slot level.

source:
你篡夺施法距离内一个你可见的亡灵生物的负能量，试图控制它。目标必须进行一次魅力豁免。若豁免失败，则目标在持续时间内陷入魅惑状态（无视任何对该状态的免疫），并对你友好。若豁免成功，则目标在你的下一回合开始前对你进行的下一次攻击检定具有劣势。若你或你的任何盟友对目标造成伤害或迫使其进行豁免检定，则法术终止。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高一环，你就可以多选择一个生物作为目标。
target:
You seize the negative energy of an Undead creature you can see within range in an attempt to control it. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it is Charmed for the duration, ignoring any immunity to that condition, and is friendly to you. On a successful save, it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of your next turn. The spell ends if you or any of your allies damage the target or force it to make a saving throw.
At Higher Levels. You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved the Charmed immunity override, the successful-save disadvantage benefit, and both early-ending triggers.

source:
你吸取一定量的一个生物所遭受的痛苦和流失的生命精华。消耗并掷出1枚生命值骰。你恢复等于骰值+你施法属性调整值的生命值。若该生物受到的伤害来自重击，则你恢复的生命值翻倍。 
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高一环，你就可以额外消耗1枚生命值骰。
target:
You draw upon some of a creature's suffering and escaping life essence. Expend and roll 1 Hit Point Die. You regain Hit Points equal to the roll + your spellcasting ability modifier. If the damage the creature took came from a Critical Hit, double the Hit Points you regain.
At Higher Levels. You can expend 1 additional Hit Point Die for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved spending the caster's Hit Point Die, Critical Hit doubling, and optional additional expenditure without inventing a trigger omitted from the body.

source: 你为一把你正在持握的武器或你的徒手打击注入贪食的负能量。在持续时间内，当你在一个回合中第一次使用被强化的武器或徒手打击命中一个生物时，目标会受到等于你施法属性调整值的暗蚀伤害，并且你获得等于所造成暗蚀伤害的临时生命值。
target: You imbue a weapon you are holding or your Unarmed Strike with ravenous negative energy. For the duration, the first time on a turn that you hit a creature with the enhanced weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target takes Necrotic damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.
note: Preserved the first hit on a turn, including turns other than the caster's, and Temporary Hit Points based on Necrotic damage dealt.

source:
你以深红色的能量鞭笞施法距离内一名你可见的生物，并在你们之间创建链接。目标必须成功通过一次体质豁免，否则将受到4d4火焰伤害并陷入束缚。陷入束缚的生物在其每个回合开始时受到2d4火焰伤害，其每个回合结束时，重新进行该豁免，成功则效应提前结束。
法术持续时间内，若目标为受禁生物，你能够以反应焚灭其身上的缄印。若如此做，目标为结束此法术效应进行的下一次豁免具有劣势。
升环施法。使用的法术位每比一环高一环，此法术的初始伤害就增加2d4，后续伤害就增加1d4。
target:
You lash a creature you can see within range with crimson energy, creating a link between you. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d4 Fire damage and be Restrained. The Restrained creature takes 2d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect early on a success.
For the spell's duration, if the target is an interdicted creature, you can use a Reaction to burn away its seal. If you do so, the target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw to end this spell's effect.
At Higher Levels. The spell's initial damage increases by 2d4 and its subsequent damage increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: The source's class-specific terms are rendered as interdicted creature and seal; their definitions are not supplied in this body. Initial and ongoing damage scale separately as written.

source:
你将手掌自腕部脱离，将其转化为一只蜘蛛形态。当蜘蛛处于你周围100尺范围内时，你可以与其进行心灵感应交流。
以一个动作，你能通过蜘蛛的感官进行观察与聆听，持续至你下个回合开始。在此期间，你自身的感官将处于耳聋与目盲状态。
若蜘蛛被消灭或无法返回，你的手掌将自动复原，但你会受到1d6心灵伤害。若你命令蜘蛛返回，它会爬回你的手腕并使法术终止。
target:
You detach your hand at the wrist and transform it into a spider. While the spider is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically.
As an action, you can see and hear through the spider's senses until the start of your next turn. During that time, you are Deafened and Blinded with regard to your own senses.
If the spider is destroyed or cannot return, your hand is automatically restored, but you take 1d6 Psychic damage. If you command the spider to return, it crawls back to your wrist and the spell ends.
note: Preserved telepathy range, sensory-action timing, damage on destruction or inability to return, and commanded return.

source:
你将目光投向天空，从更高有利位置观测。你通过一个隐形的传感器投射你的视野，该感应器会出现在你上方 120 尺处的位置。你可以如同正飞行一样透过传感器进行观察、从传感器的位置可以 360度全方位观察。传感器会随着你的移动而移动，并保持相对于你的高度。你可以使用附赠动作调整传感器的高度，但最多只能调整到距离你120尺的高度。
通过传感器观察时，你会陷入目盲，但你可以在通过传感器或通过自己的眼睛观察之间切换。
context: column:M;spell:Elevated Sight;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:1
target:
You cast your gaze into the sky to observe from a higher vantage point. Your sight is projected through an Invisible sensor that appears 120 feet above you. You can look through the sensor as though you were flying, with a 360-degree view from its position. The sensor moves with you and maintains its height relative to you. You can use a Bonus Action to adjust its height, to a maximum height of 120 feet from you.
While looking through the sensor, you are Blinded, but you can switch between looking through the sensor and through your own eyes.
note: Preserved the sensor's relative movement, full view, height limit, and switching option. The source does not assign an action cost to switching eyes.

source:
由魔法力场构成的尖刺般的虚无屏障阻挡在你和攻击者之间。当你被近战攻击命中时，屏障令你受到的伤害降低 2d4，并对攻击者造成等量的穿刺伤害。屏障对远程攻击无效，但仍可在法术持续期间AC+2(视为半掩护）以抵抗它。
升环施法。当你使用2环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比1环高1环，法术的效果提高1d4。
context: column:M;spell:Spiny Shield;book:谦卑林战役设定集;level:1
target:
An intangible, spiked barrier of magical force intervenes between you and an attacker. When you are hit by a melee attack, the barrier reduces the damage you take by 2d4 and deals the same amount of Piercing damage to the attacker. The barrier does not have this effect against ranged attacks, but it still grants +2 AC against them for the spell's duration, treated as Half Cover.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level 2 or higher, the spell's effect increases by 1d4 for each 1 slot level above 1.
note: Preserved the separate ranged-attack AC benefit and melee damage reduction/retaliation. The source calls scaling an increase to the effect without explicitly separating the two melee amounts.

source:
当你施展此法术时，你会用材料成分切割你的身体，你的最大值生命值减少3点，材料成分消失。在法术持续期间，你可以使用一个附赠动作从你身上抽出一把由你自己的骨头、血液和肌腱制成的剑。这是一种魔法武器，当你使用它攻击时使用你的法术攻击加值，并在命中时造成1d6点挥砍伤害。你视为熟练这把武器。作为附赠动作，你可以将剑刃滑回身体以隐藏它。当持续时间结束时，你身体上的切口消失，你的最大值生命值恢复，材料成分重新出现。
升环施法。当你用三环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，每比一环高二环，该武器命中额外造成1d6点伤害，且你的最大生命值额外减少，等同所用的法术位的环阶。
context: column:M;spell:Blade of Blood and Bone;book:黯潮之书;level:1
target:
When you cast this spell, you cut your body with the Material component. Your Hit Point maximum decreases by 3, and the Material component disappears. For the duration, you can use a Bonus Action to draw a sword made of your own bone, blood, and sinew from your body. It is a magic weapon that uses your spell attack bonus when you attack with it and deals 1d6 Slashing damage on a hit. You are proficient with the weapon. As a Bonus Action, you can slide the blade back into your body to conceal it. When the duration ends, the cut in your body disappears, your Hit Point maximum is restored, and the Material component reappears.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 damage on a hit for every two slot levels above level one, and your Hit Point maximum is further reduced by an amount equal to the level of the spell slot used.
note: Preserved component disappearance/restoration and both Bonus Actions. The additional Hit Point maximum reduction is stated separately as equal to the slot level, without silently multiplying it by the damage-scaling steps.

source:
你扭转施法距离内一可见生物的好运。当目标进行属性检定时必须先进行一次魅力豁免，豁免失败则检定直接失败。此法术一旦施展就会持续生效，即使目标移出范围外也是如此。如果使用更高环阶的法术位施放，每一个后续效果都会添加到上述效果中。
如果目标最终检定成功（或在升环施法效果中的最终攻击或豁免成功），那么你会受到1点心灵伤害。如果你失去了对该法术的专注，则会受到1d4点心灵伤害。
升环施法。当你使用二环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，当目标进行豁免时，它必须以魅力豁免代替该豁免，除非原豁免更为困难。当你使用四环或更高环阶的法术位施展该法术时，当目标进行攻击前必须进行一次魅力豁免，豁免失败攻击直接失手。当你使用八环法术位施展该法术时，此法术则无需专注。
context: column:M;spell:Doom of poor fortune;book:黯潮之书;level:1
target:
You turn the good fortune of a creature you can see within range against it. Whenever the target makes an ability check, it must first make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the check automatically fails. Once cast, this spell remains in effect even if the target moves out of range. When cast using a higher-level spell slot, each subsequent effect is added to the effects above.
If the target ultimately succeeds on the check, or on the attack or saving throw affected by the higher-level effects, you take 1 Psychic damage. If you lose Concentration on the spell, you take 1d4 Psychic damage.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level two or higher, whenever the target makes a saving throw, it must make a Charisma saving throw instead, unless the original save is more difficult. When you use a spell slot of level four or higher, the target must make a Charisma saving throw before making an attack; on a failed save, the attack automatically misses. When you use a level-eight spell slot, the spell does not require Concentration.
note: Preserved cumulative higher-level effects, both caster damage triggers, and the source's exact level-eight wording. More difficult is not defined by the source and remains unresolved.

source: 你装作以一把微型弓箭射箭。对施法距离内的一名生物进行一次远程法术攻击。被命中的目标生物会向一个随机方向（掷d8并为每个骰面指定一个方向）踉跄的被推向该方向5尺，其速度变为0，直到其下一回合结束。在本法术结束前，你可以在每个回合中以一个动作再次这样攻击。
target: You pretend to shoot an arrow from a miniature bow. Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the creature staggers and is pushed 5 feet in a random direction, determined by rolling a d8 and assigning a direction to each face, and its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. Until the spell ends, you can make this attack again as an action on each turn.
note: Preserved random direction, push distance, zero Speed timing, and repeat-action attack without adding damage.

source:
你摸碰一个酒器，并将橡子粉撒入其中，令其变成一个闪闪发光的绿色容器，里面装满了绿色药水。任何从酒杯中饮酒的生物能在1天内免受暗影侵蚀。这种保护会带来一些额外的好处：
在影域内采集食物时进行的检定具优势，并获得30尺黑暗视觉（或将你现有的黑暗视觉增加30尺）。
target:
You touch a drinking vessel and sprinkle powdered acorn into it, transforming it into a sparkling green vessel filled with green potion. Any creature that drinks from the goblet is protected from shadow corruption for 1 day. This protection has additional benefits:
Advantage on checks to gather food in the Shadow Realm, and Darkvision out to 30 feet, or an increase of 30 feet to your existing Darkvision.
note: Preserved the one-day protection and both additional benefits. Shadow corruption and Shadow Realm are source setting terms not defined in this passage.

source:
魔法的暮色从你选择的一点为中心半径50尺的球体内在法术持续期间弥散。逐渐弥散的暮色会蔓延到区域内的角落。
拥有黑暗视觉的生物可以看穿它，任何普通光照都能照亮它。任何穿过暮色朦胧区域的远程攻击具有劣势。
如果你将法术目标设置于你正持握或未被穿着携带的物件，则暮色将从物件周围漫出并跟随物件移动。将该物件完全掩盖时（比如用碗或头盔盖住），也会将其漫出的暮色隔绝。
如果该法术区域与任何二环或更高环阶法术创造的光亮区域重叠，则该法术效应会被解除。
target:
Magical twilight spreads for the duration in a Sphere with a radius of 50 feet centered on a point you choose. The spreading twilight reaches around corners within the area.
Creatures with Darkvision can see through it, and any ordinary light can illuminate it. Any ranged attack passing through the dim twilight has Disadvantage.
If you target an object you are holding or an object that is neither worn nor carried, the twilight emanates from the object and moves with it. Completely covering the object, such as with a bowl or helmet, also blocks the twilight it emits.
If the spell's area overlaps an area of light created by any spell of level two or higher, this spell's effect is dispelled.
note: Preserved visibility through twilight, ordinary-light interaction, moving object and covering rules, and dispelling by a level-two-or-higher light spell.

source: 你选择施法距离内一点，召唤大量的萤火虫。在法术持续期间照亮该点半径15尺内的球体范围。一些萤火虫会落在躲藏的或隐形的生物上，这让它们更容易被发现。攻击该区域内隐形的生物不再具有劣势，尽管隐形生物的攻击仍具有优势，因为只有它们的大致位置被萤火虫的光所照亮，而不是具体的轨迹。在该区域内所有的躲藏都具有劣势。
target: You choose a point within range and summon a multitude of fireflies. For the duration, they illuminate a Sphere with a radius of 15 feet centered on that point. Some fireflies land on hidden or Invisible creatures, making them easier to find. Attacks against Invisible creatures in the area no longer have Disadvantage, though the Invisible creatures' attacks still have Advantage, since the fireflies' light reveals only their approximate positions, not their precise movements. All attempts to hide in the area have Disadvantage.
note: Preserved the asymmetric Invisible attack effects and the separate hiding penalty; no complete removal of invisibility was added.

source:
你为一个生物带来一点坏运气，让它看起来滑稽可笑。创造以下效果之一：
一个小小的油性水坑出现在你的目标的脚下，导致它失去平衡。目标必须成功通过一次敏捷豁免，否则无法在其下一回合使用附赠动作，因为它需重新站稳。
微小的颗粒吹到你的目标脸上，导致它打喷嚏。目标必须通过一次体质豁免，否则在其下一回合的第一次攻击具有劣势。
闪光灯在目标眼前短暂闪烁，造成其视力障碍。目标必须通过一次体质豁免，否则其被动察觉减半，直到其下回合结束。
目标感到耳朵上有一种快速、温和的拍打感，使其短暂迷失方向。目标必须通过一次体质豁免才能维持专注。
一股看不见的力量猛拉着目标的裤子，导致他们的衣服滑落。目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免，否则目标在其下回合结束前的下一次使用双手武器的攻击具有劣势，或者在下一回合结束前失去其盾牌提供的护甲等级加值，因为它需使用单手提裤子。
同一时间只能对一个生物使用其中一种效果。
target:
You bring a little bad luck to a creature, making it look ridiculous. Create one of the following effects:
A small, oily puddle appears beneath the target's feet, causing it to lose its balance. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be unable to use a Bonus Action on its next turn as it regains its footing.
Tiny particles blow into the target's face and make it sneeze. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have Disadvantage on its first attack on its next turn.
A brief flash before the target's eyes impairs its vision. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have its Passive Perception halved until the end of its next turn.
The target feels a quick, gentle slap against its ear, momentarily disorienting it. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration.
An unseen force tugs hard at the target's trousers, causing its clothing to slip. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have Disadvantage on its next attack with a Two-Handed weapon before the end of its next turn, or lose its shield's AC bonus until the end of its next turn, because it must use one hand to hold up its trousers.
At a time, you can use only one of these effects on one creature.
note: All five pranks, their distinct saves and durations, and the final one-effect/one-creature-at-a-time restriction are retained. The source does not identify who chooses between the trousers effect's two consequences.

source:
你释放出一道耀眼的焰能爆。对施法距离内的一个目标发动一次远程法术攻击；结算该次攻击检定时目标无法从半身掩护和四分之三掩护中获益。若命中，则目标受到2d10光耀伤害。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，你便可额外发射一道焰能爆。你可以令这发新的焰能爆瞄准你原先的目标或是另一个目标。每道焰能爆都需要分别进行攻击。
context: column:M;spell:Spellfire Flare;book:被遗忘的国度：费伦英雄;level:1
target:
You release a dazzling blast of spellfire. Make a ranged spell attack against a target within range. The target gains no benefit from Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover for that attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 2d10 Radiant damage.
At Higher Levels. You can fire one additional blast for each spell slot level above level one. You can aim the new blast at the original target or another target. Make a separate attack for each blast.
note: Preserved cover bypass, Radiant damage, and separate attacks for additional blasts without changing the source's target eligibility.

source:
你向施法距离内的一名生物掷出一片令其晕眩的魔法力场。目标进行一次体质豁免（构装和亡灵自动豁免成功）。豁免失败则目标受2d4力场伤害，其速度减半至你的下一回合开始，且目标在其下一回合中仅可以执行一个动作或一个附赠动作（但不能同时执行二者）。豁免成功则仅受半伤。
升环施法。你使用的法术位每比一环高一环，法术的伤害就增加2d4。
target:
You hurl a disorienting patch of magical force at a creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw; Constructs and Undead automatically succeed. On a failed save, the target takes 2d4 Force damage, its Speed is halved until the start of your next turn, and on its next turn it can take either an action or a Bonus Action, but not both. On a successful save, it takes only half damage.
At Higher Levels. The spell's damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above level one.
note: Preserved automatic saves for Constructs/Undead and separate timing for the Speed and action restrictions.

source:
你变换了自身形态。施法时，从以下选项中选择其一生效，其效应维持至其持续时间结束。在持续时间内，你还能够以一个魔法动作将效应切换为另一个不同的选项。
　　• 水生适应Aquatic Adaptation。 你长出鳃和蹼。你可以在水下呼吸，并且获得等同于步行速度的游泳速度。
　　• 改变外貌Change Appearance。你改变了自己的外貌。你可以自行设定自己的外观：包括身高、体重、面部细节、声线、头发长短、肤色以及（可能具有的）独特外貌特征。你可以让自己的外观形似其他种族的一员而你的任何数据都不会变化。你无法变为一个体型不同的生物，并且你的基础身体轮廓不会变化。例如，如果你两足行动，就不能变为四足生物。你可以在持续时间内以一个魔法动作改变这些外貌细节。
　　• 天生武器Natural Weapons。 你长出爪子（挥砍）、獠牙（穿刺）、犄角（穿刺）或蹄（钝击）。当你使用徒手打击以这些新长的器官造成伤害时，它会造成1d6对应类型伤害，而非你通常的徒手打击伤害，并且你使用你的施法关键属性调整值而非力量调整值来作为攻击和伤害的调整值。
target:
You transform your physical form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, whose effect lasts for the duration. During the duration, you can also use a Magic action to switch to a different option.
• Aquatic Adaptation. You grow gills and webbing. You can breathe underwater and gain a Swim Speed equal to your walking speed.
• Change Appearance. You alter your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, voice, hair length, skin color, and any distinguishing features. You can look like a member of another species without changing any of your statistics. You cannot become a creature of a different size, and your basic body shape does not change. For example, if you are bipedal, you cannot become quadrupedal. You can use a Magic action during the duration to change these details of your appearance.
• Natural Weapons. You grow claws (Slashing), fangs (Piercing), horns (Piercing), or hooves (Bludgeoning). When you use an Unarmed Strike to deal damage with these new features, it deals 1d6 damage of the corresponding type instead of your normal Unarmed Strike damage, and you use your spellcasting ability modifier instead of your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls.
note: Preserved all three complete options, both Magic-action changes, body-shape limits, and the 2024 spellcasting-modifier Natural Weapons wording.

source:
指定一只在施法距离内你能看见的微型野兽。该生物必须成功通过一次魅力豁免，否则它会为你传递一则消息（如果该生物的挑战等级不是0，则豁免自动成功）。你选择一个你曾造访过的地点，然后描述收信人的基本信息，如“一个穿着城镇守卫制服的男人或女人”或“一个戴着尖顶帽子的红发矮人”。你还需要说出一段不超过二十五个单次的信息。目标野兽 将会在法术持续时间内前往你选定的地点。会飞的信使24小时内可移动50里，不会飞的信使只能移动25里。
野兽抵达目的地后，会模仿你的声音把信息传递给你描述的人。信使只会把信息传递给符合你描述的人。如果法术持续时间内信使未能抵达目的地则信息将遗失，而曾作为信使的野兽将自行寻路返回你施法的地点。
升环施法： 使用的法术位每比2环高一环，此法术持续时间就增加48小时。
target:
Choose a Tiny Beast you can see within range. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or carry a message for you; it automatically succeeds if its Challenge Rating is not 0. Choose a location you have visited and describe the recipient in general terms, such as "a man or woman wearing a town guard's uniform" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also speak a message of no more than twenty-five words. The target Beast travels toward the chosen location for the duration. A flying messenger can travel 50 li in 24 hours; a nonflying messenger can travel only 25 li.
When the Beast reaches its destination, it delivers the message to the person you described, imitating your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching your description. If it does not reach its destination before the duration ends, the message is lost, and the Beast finds its own way back to where you cast the spell.
At Higher Levels: The spell's duration increases by 48 hours for each spell slot level above level 2.
note: The source's bare distance unit li is preserved, not converted to miles; unit verification remains pending. Its apparent typo for words in the message limit is translated as words. The CR 0 save condition and all delivery/failure rules are retained.

source: 你触碰一个关着的门、窗、容器或出入口，并使目标在法术持续时间内被魔法上锁。秘法锁无法被任何非魔法方式解锁。在你施展法术时你可以选择允许一些其他生物，你和受你允许的生物能够无视秘法锁打开/关闭该物件。你还可以设置一条密语，在该物件5尺内念出密语时，秘法锁将被解锁（持续1分钟）。
target: You touch a closed door, window, container, or entryway and magically lock it for the duration. Arcane Lock cannot be unlocked by any nonmagical means. When you cast the spell, you can designate other creatures; you and those creatures can open and close the object while ignoring the Arcane Lock. You can also set a password. Speaking it within 5 feet of the object unlocks the Arcane Lock for 1 minute.
note: Preserved the source's absolute nonmagical-unlocking restriction and the separate designated-creature/password access methods.

source:
你利用自己的生命力来治愈自身。投一枚或两枚你还未消耗的生命骰，然后回复等于结果加你的施法属性调整值的总和的生命值。随后，这些生命骰会被法术消耗。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，你就能多投掷一枚未使用的生命骰。
target:
You draw on your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two of your unexpended Hit Point Dice, and regain Hit Points equal to the total rolled + your spellcasting ability modifier. Those Hit Point Dice are then expended by the spell.
At Higher Levels: You can roll one additional unexpended Hit Point Die for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved spending previously unexpended dice and adding the spellcasting modifier once to the total.

source:
你从异界存在处获得对某道有关你在接下来的30分钟内所计划执行的一系列行动之结果的预示。DM从下列预示中选取一个：

预兆 预示着… 
吉 好的结果。 
凶 坏的结果。 
吉凶并存 结果既有好的方面，也有坏的方面。 
无 结果并无明显的好坏分别。 

该法术将不会对任何环境因素进行解释，比如可能会对结果产生改变的一些其他法术。若你在两次长休之间使用两次或更多次的卜筮术，则法术在第一次施展之后会每次累积25%概率会不给出任何结果。
target:
You receive an omen from an otherworldly being about the outcome of a course of action you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The DM chooses one of the following omens:

Omen | Foretells...
Weal | A good outcome.
Woe | A bad outcome.
Weal and Woe | An outcome with both good and bad aspects.
Nothing | An outcome that is neither clearly good nor bad.

The spell does not account for any surrounding factors, such as other spells that might change the outcome. If you cast Augury twice or more between Long Rests, each casting after the first has a cumulative 25% chance of giving no result.
note: Preserved all four omen rows and the 2024 cumulative chance of no result, not a random reading.

source:
处于你施法范围内的一个你可见的生物必须进行一次体质豁免，豁免失败者在法术持续期间陷入目盲或耳聋状态（由你选择）。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重复此豁免，直至豁免成功时结束自己身上的效应。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，你就能多指定一个生物作为法术目标。
target:
A creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is Blinded or Deafened, your choice, for the duration. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the chosen condition, repeated end-of-turn saves, and additional-target scaling.

source:
你指定施法距离内一点，以该点为源点半径20尺球状区域内的每个类人生物必须成功通过一次魅力豁免，否则将受下列效应之一影响（由你分别为每名生物选择生效的效应）。
直到法术结束，该生物免疫魅惑和恐慌状态。如果该生物已经陷入魅惑或恐慌状态，则这些状态在持续时间内被压制。
该生物对你选择的之前敌对的生物态度变为冷漠。该冷漠态度持续到目标受到伤害或者看到自己的盟友受到伤害。当法术结束时，该生物恢复到原本的态度。
target:
Choose a point within range. Each Humanoid in a Sphere with a radius of 20 feet centered on that point must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects. You choose the effect separately for each creature.
Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to the Charmed and Frightened conditions. If it already has either condition, those conditions are suppressed for the duration.
The creature becomes indifferent toward creatures of your choice to which it was previously hostile. This indifference lasts until the target takes damage or sees an ally take damage. When the spell ends, the creature returns to its original attitude.
note: Preserved per-creature choice, condition immunity plus suppression, and the damage-triggered end of indifference.

source:
你指定施法距离内一点，在以该点为中心的5尺立方区域内咒唤出旋转的匕首。区域内的每名生物受到4d4点挥砍伤害。每当立方区域移动到一名生物区域内时、一名生物进入立方区域或是在该区域结束其回合时，该生物同样会受到此伤害。一名生物一回合中只会受到一次该伤害。
在你后续的回合中，你能够以一个魔法动作将立方区域传送至多30尺。
升环施法。 使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加2d4。
target:
Choose a point within range and conjure spinning daggers in a 5-foot Cube centered on it. Each creature in the area takes 4d4 Slashing damage. A creature also takes this damage whenever the Cube moves into its space, it enters the Cube, or it ends its turn there. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
On your subsequent turns, you can use a Magic action to teleport the Cube up to 30 feet.
At Higher Levels. The spell's damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the 2024 movable Cube, immediate damage, all three subsequent triggers, and once-per-turn limit.

source:
你触碰至多四根非魔法箭矢或弩矢，将其插在位于你所处空间的地面上。直到法术结束为止，这些弹药不能被物理方法拔起，且当除你之外的生物第一次进入距弹药30尺内空间或在距弹药30尺内空间结束回合时，一枚弹药便会飞起攻击此生物。那名生物必须成功于一次敏捷豁免，否则受到2d4点穿刺伤害。那枚弹药随之被摧毁。当所有弹药都没有插在地面上时，法术终止。
施展该法术时，你可以指定任意名你选择的生物，法术效应将无视他们。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，可被影响的弹药数量就增加两枚。
target:
You touch up to four nonmagical arrows or bolts and plant them in the ground in your space. Until the spell ends, the ammunition cannot be pulled out by physical means. When a creature other than you first enters a space within 30 feet of the ammunition or ends its turn within 30 feet of it, one piece of ammunition flies up to attack that creature. The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d4 Piercing damage. That piece of ammunition is then destroyed. The spell ends when none of the ammunition remains planted in the ground.
When you cast the spell, you can designate any number of creatures of your choice to be ignored by its effect.
At Higher Levels: The amount of ammunition you can affect increases by two pieces for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the source's first-entry wording without adding a per-turn qualifier, end-of-turn trigger, physical-removal restriction, and ignored creatures.

source:
一名施法距离内你可见的生物必须成功于一次感知豁免，否则于法术持续时间内陷入魅惑状态。非类人生物自动成功于此豁免。
一顶虚体王冠出现在被魅惑目标的头顶，且目标每回合必须在移动之前使用其动作对除自身以外你精神性选择的目标发动一次近战攻击。若你并未选择任何生物，或目标触及内没有生物，则目标可在其回合正常行动。目标在其每回合结束时都可以重新豁免，豁免成功则结束其身上该法术的效应。
在施法后，你在每个自己回合里必须用一个魔法动作维持对目标的控制，否则法术将终止。
target:
A creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed for the duration. Non-Humanoids automatically succeed on this save.
An insubstantial crown appears above the Charmed target's head. On each of its turns, before moving, the target must use its action to make a melee attack against a target other than itself that you choose mentally. If you choose no creature, or no creature is within the target's reach, it can act normally on its turn. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the save, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
After casting the spell, you must use a Magic action on each of your turns to maintain control of the target, or the spell ends.
note: Preserved non-Humanoid automatic success, attack-before-movement order, normal-action exceptions, and the caster's continuing Magic-action cost.

source:
你指定施法距离内一点，并在法术持续时间内使魔法性黑暗充斥以该点为中心半径15尺的球状区域。黑暗视觉也无法看穿这这种黑暗，非魔法的光照也无法将其照亮。
或者，你可以将此法术施展于一个未被着装或携带的物件上，使黑暗充斥以该物件为中心的15尺光环区域。将该物件用不透明的东西遮掩（比如用碗或头盔盖住）时，会将黑暗Darkness隔绝。
如果法术区域与任何二环或更低环阶法术创造的明亮光照或微光光照 区域重叠，则这些造光的法术将被解除。
target:
Choose a point within range. Magical Darkness fills a Sphere with a radius of 15 feet centered on that point for the duration. Darkvision cannot see through this Darkness, and nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.
Alternatively, you can cast the spell on an object that is neither worn nor carried, causing Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation centered on the object. Covering the object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helmet, blocks the Darkness.
If the spell's area overlaps an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by any spell of level two or lower, the spells creating that light are dispelled.
note: Preserved the separate Sphere and object-centered Emanation options, object eligibility, and dispelling of lower-level light spells.

source:
你激活下述效应之一。直到法术结束为止，你可以在你随后的回合用一个魔法动作以激活下述任意效应之一。
　　• 感知思想Sense Thoughts。 你感知距你30尺内，知晓语言或能够心灵感应的思想的存在。你并不会阅读这些思想，但你知道这里存在一名有理智的生物。
此法术会被1尺厚的岩石、泥土或木头，1寸厚的金属，或薄薄一层铅阻隔。
　　• 阅读思想Read Thoughts。选择一名距你30尺内的可见生物，或一名距你30尺内被感知思想 侦测到的生物。你了解到此时目标最关心的事情。如果目标不知晓任何语言也不会心灵感应，则你不能得到任何信息。
在你的下一回合，用一个魔法动作，你可以尝试深入目标的心灵。如果你选择这么做，目标进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败，则你了解到他的逻辑推理、情绪状态以及他头脑中的一些大事（比如忧虑、挚爱和仇恨的事物）。豁免成功，法术终止。无论哪种情况，目标都会知道你正在窥探其心灵，且直到你的注意力从它的心灵上移开为止，目标均可以在其回合内使用动作进行一次智力（奥秘）检定，对抗你的法术豁免DC，目标胜出对抗时，法术终止。
target:
You activate one of the following effects. Until the spell ends, you can use a Magic action on your subsequent turns to activate either effect.
• Sense Thoughts. You sense the presence of thoughts within 30 feet of you belonging to creatures that know a language or can communicate telepathically. You do not read those thoughts, but you know that a thinking creature is present.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, earth, or wood, 1 cun of metal, or a thin sheet of lead.
• Read Thoughts. Choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, or a creature within 30 feet of you detected by Sense Thoughts. You learn what is currently foremost on the target's mind. If the target knows no languages and cannot communicate telepathically, you learn nothing.
On your next turn, you can use a Magic action to try to probe deeper into the target's mind. If you do, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you learn its reasoning, emotional state, and some matters that loom large in its mind, such as things it worries about, loves, or hates. On a successful save, the spell ends. Either way, the target knows you are probing its mind. Until you shift your attention away from its mind, the target can use its action on its turn to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against your spell save DC, ending the spell on a success.
note: The unqualified metal-thickness unit cun is preserved pending unit verification. Both modes, barriers, failed-language condition, deeper probe timing, awareness, and escape check are retained.

source:
你触摸一名自愿生物，然后从强酸、寒冷、火焰、闪电或毒素中任选其一。在法术结束之前，目标可以用一个魔法动作呼出15尺锥形范围的吐息。区域内的所有生物进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败受到3d6点所选类型的伤害，豁免成功只受一半伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就提高1d6。
target:
You touch a willing creature and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Until the spell ends, the target can use a Magic action to exhale a breath weapon in a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved all five damage choices, the Magic action, Cone dimensions, and save results.

source:
你触碰一名生物并在力量、敏捷、智力、感知、魅力中选择一项属性。法术持续时间内，目标在使用所选属性进行的属性检定具有优势。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，你就可以额外指定一个目标。你可以分别为每个目标选择一项属性。
target:
You touch a creature and choose one ability: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has Advantage on ability checks using the chosen ability.
At Higher Levels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above level two. You can choose a different ability for each target.
note: Preserved the source's five listed abilities, excluding Constitution, and separate choices for additional targets.

source:
在法术持续时间内，法术使施法距离内一个你可见的生物或物件的大小发生改变（见下可选效应）。若你以物件为目标，则其不能被着装或携带。如果目标为非自愿生物，则其可以进行一次体质豁免。豁免成功则法术无效。
如果目标是生物，则其着装物和携带物的尺寸也随之变化。随后任何从该生物身上脱离的物品都会立即恢复为正常大小。投掷武器和弹药在命中目标或失手后会恢复为正常大小。
　　• 变巨Enlarge。目标的体型增大一级（例如从中型变为大型）。目标在力量检定和力量豁免时具有优势。目标使用变巨的武器发动攻击或进行徒手打击 时，命中时将额外造成1d4点伤害。
　　• 缩小Reduce。目标的体型缩小一级（例如从中型变为小型）。目标在力量检定和力量豁免时具有劣势。目标使用缩小的武器发动攻击或进行徒手打击 时，命中时将额外减少1d4点伤害（以此法无法将该伤害降至1以下）。
target:
For the duration, the spell changes the size of a creature or object you can see within range, using one of the options below. An object you target must be neither worn nor carried. An unwilling creature can make a Constitution saving throw; on a success, the spell has no effect.
If the target is a creature, everything it wears and carries changes size with it. Any item that subsequently leaves the creature immediately returns to its normal size. Thrown weapons and ammunition return to normal size after they hit or miss a target.
• Enlarge. The target's size increases by one category, such as from Medium to Large. The target has Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. When it hits with an enlarged weapon or an Unarmed Strike, it deals an extra 1d4 damage.
• Reduce. The target's size decreases by one category, such as from Medium to Small. The target has Disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. When it hits with a reduced weapon or an Unarmed Strike, it deals 1d4 less damage; this cannot reduce the damage below 1.
note: Preserved both size-category effects, Unarmed Strikes, item reversion, and the thrown-weapon/ammunition timing exception.

source: 你编排一段使人分心的话语，指定施法距离内任何你能看见的生物。目标生物必须进行一次感知豁免。如果你或你的同伴正在和目标生物战斗，则其自动成功于该豁免。豁免失败时，目标直到法术终止之前进行的感知（察觉）检定与被动察觉 值具有-10减值。
target: You weave a distracting stream of words and target any creatures you can see within range. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw. If you or your companions are fighting a target, it automatically succeeds on the save. On a failed save, the target has a −10 penalty to Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception until the spell ends.
note: Preserved the source's fixed Perception penalty and automatic success during combat without substituting an older Enthrall effect.

source:
你召唤某个异界存在作为忠诚坐骑，坐骑会出现在施法范围内你选择的未占据空间中。此生物使用异界坐骑Otherworldly Steed 的数据。如果你已经有一只以此法术获得的坐骑，则其会被新坐骑替代。
坐骑看起来像一匹大型的可骑乘动物（由你选择），比如一匹马，一头骆驼，一只恐狼或一头驼鹿。你在施展此法术时从下述三种生物类型中选择坐骑的生物类型：天族、妖精、邪魔，其数据中的特定特质由坐骑的生物类型决定。

异界坐骑Otherworldly Steed 
大型天族、妖精或邪魔（由你选择），绝对中立
AC 10+法术环阶
HP 5+每法术环阶10点（坐骑拥有等同于法术环阶数量的d10生命骰）
速度 60尺，飞行60尺（需要法术为四环或以上）
力量18|+4|+4 敏捷12|+1|+1 体质14|+2|+2
智力6|-2|-2 感知12|+1|+1 魅力8|-1|-1
感官 被动察觉11
语言 心灵感应1里（仅对你生效）
CR无（XP0；PB等同于你的熟练加值）
特质Traits
生命连接Life Bond。 当你从一道一环或以上的法术中恢复生命值时，若你位于坐骑5尺内，则坐骑也会恢复相同数量的生命值。
动作Actions
异界猛击Otherworldly Slam。近战攻击检定：加值等同于你的法术攻击调整值，触及5尺。命中：1d8+法术环阶点光耀（天族）、心灵（妖精）、黯蚀（邪魔）伤害。
附赠动作Bonus Actions 
堕落凝视Fell Glare（仅限邪魔，长休充能）。 感知豁免：DC等同于你的法术豁免DC，一名距坐骑60尺内的可见生物。失败：目标直到你下个回合结束为止陷入恐慌状态。
妖精跨步Fey Step（仅限妖精，长休充能）。坐骑连同其骑手传送至你选择的距其60尺内未占空间中。
治愈之触Healing Touch（仅限天族，长休充能）。一名距坐骑5尺内的生物恢复2d8+法术环阶点生命值。

战斗Combat。坐骑是你和你盟友的盟友。战斗时，它共用你的先攻，并在你骑乘它期间视同受控坐骑（如骑乘战斗规则中所定义）。如果你具有失能状态，则坐骑会在你的回合之后立刻进行自己的回合并独立行动，集中精力保护你。
坐骑的消失Disappearance of the Steed。坐骑在其降至0生命值或你死亡时会消失。当它消失时，它会将自己穿着或携带的任何物品留下。如果你再次施展此法术，你决定是重新召唤消失的那头坐骑还是召唤一头不同的。
升环施法： 在生物数据中使用更高的法术环阶。
target:
You summon an otherworldly being to serve as a loyal mount. It appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and uses the Otherworldly Steed stat block. If you already have a steed from this spell, the new steed replaces it.
The steed resembles a Large rideable animal of your choice, such as a horse, camel, dire wolf, or elk. When you cast the spell, choose its creature type: Celestial, Fey, or Fiend. Certain traits in its stat block depend on that choice.

Otherworldly Steed
Large Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice), Neutral
AC 10 + the spell's level
HP 5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of d10 Hit Point Dice equal to the spell's level)
Speed 60 feet, Fly 60 feet (requires a spell level of four or higher)
Ability | Score | Modifier | Save
Strength | 18 | +4 | +4
Dexterity | 12 | +1 | +1
Constitution | 14 | +2 | +2
Intelligence | 6 | −2 | −2
Wisdom | 12 | +1 | +1
Charisma | 8 | −1 | −1
Senses Passive Perception 11
Languages Telepathy 1 li (only with you)
CR None (XP 0; PB equals your Proficiency Bonus)
Traits
Life Bond. When you regain Hit Points from a spell of level one or higher while within 5 feet of the steed, it regains the same number of Hit Points.
Actions
Otherworldly Slam. Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet. Hit: 1d8 + the spell's level in Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.
Bonus Actions
Fell Glare (Fiend Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC; one creature the steed can see within 60 feet of it. Failure: The target is Frightened until the end of your next turn.
Fey Step (Fey Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). The steed and its rider teleport to an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet of it.
Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest). One creature within 5 feet of the steed regains 2d8 + the spell's level in Hit Points.

Combat. The steed is an ally of you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative and counts as a controlled mount while you ride it, as defined in the mounted combat rules. If you have the Incapacitated condition, the steed takes its own turn immediately after yours and acts independently, focusing on protecting you.
Disappearance of the Steed. The steed disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or you die. When it disappears, it leaves behind anything it was wearing or carrying. If you cast this spell again, you decide whether to summon the vanished steed again or a different one.
At Higher Levels: Use the higher spell level in the creature's stat block.
note: The complete stat block, all six ability rows, three type-specific Bonus Actions, and combat/disappearance rules are retained. Telepathy uses bare li in the source; li is preserved pending unit verification, not converted to miles. The two numeric columns after each ability score are labeled Modifier and Save from the stat-block layout.

source:
你感测到施法距离范围内，且在你视觉线范围内的任何陷阱。该法术的目标“陷阱”包括任何创造意图是造成伤害或其他危害的物件或装置。因此该法术可以感测警报术Alarm和守卫刻文Glyph of Warding ，也可以发现某个陷坑型机械陷阱。不过它不能揭示地板的某处自然产生的脆弱点，或某处不稳定的天花板，又或是某个隐藏的陷坑。
该法术只单纯揭示陷阱的存在而不能得知陷阱的位置。不过你可以知晓所感测到陷阱其能够构成危害的大致形式。
target:
