You sense any traps within range and within your line of sight. For this spell, a "trap" includes any object or mechanism created with the intent to cause damage or other harm. Thus, the spell can detect Alarm and Glyph of Warding, as well as a mechanical pit trap. It does not reveal a naturally weak spot in a floor, an unstable ceiling, or a hidden pit.
The spell reveals only that a trap is present, not its location. However, you learn the general nature of the harm posed by a trap you sense.
note: Preserved all examples, including the source's apparent tension between detecting a mechanical pit trap and not revealing a hidden pit; no external rule correction was applied.

source:
你在一只空手上召出一把火焰刀。该刀刃的尺寸和形状近似于一把弯刀并在法术持续时间内持续存在。当你放下刀刃时其将消失不见，但你可以用一个附赠动作重新将其唤出。
你可以用一个魔法动作使用该火焰刀发动一次近战法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到3d6+你的施法属性调整值点火焰伤害。
火焰刀提供半径10尺的明亮光照，以及额外10尺的微光光照。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d6。
target:
You evoke a fiery blade in an empty hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a Scimitar and lasts for the duration. If you let go of it, it disappears, but you can evoke it again with a Bonus Action.
You can use a Magic action to make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade. On a hit, the target takes Fire damage equal to 3d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
The blade sheds Bright Light in a radius of 10 feet and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the 2024 spellcasting modifier in damage, Magic-action attack, Bonus-action recall, lighting, and scaling.

source:
一颗直径5尺的火焰球显现在施法距离内地面上的一处未被占据的空间，并在法术持续时间内持续存在。任何生物在火球周围5尺内结束其回合时必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到2d6点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
你可以用一个附赠动作将火球沿着地面移动30尺。如果你将火球移入某名生物所占据的空间，则该生物必须进行对抗火球伤害的豁免，而火球在该回合内停止移动。
移动火球时，你可以指引它越过不高于5尺的障碍，或者越过不宽过10尺的陷坑。被火球触碰的任何未被着装或携带的可燃物件都会开始燃烧。火球向其周围散发出半径20尺的明亮光照，以及额外20尺的微光光照。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，其伤害就增加1d6。
target:
A Sphere of fire 5 feet in diameter appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the Sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
You can use a Bonus Action to move the Sphere 30 feet along the ground. If you move it into a creature's space, that creature must make the save against the Sphere's damage, and the Sphere stops moving for that turn.
When moving the Sphere, you can direct it over barriers no more than 5 feet high and across pits no more than 10 feet wide. Any flammable object it touches that is neither worn nor carried begins to burn. The Sphere sheds Bright Light in a radius of 20 feet and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
At Higher Levels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved ground movement, collision stop, both obstacle limits, ignition eligibility, and both lighting radii.

source: 你触碰一具尸体或其他遗骸。目标在法术持续时间内不会腐烂且无法被转变为亡灵Undead。该法术同样可以有效的延长复活目标的时间限制，因为受该法术影响下度过的时间不计入法术如死者复活Raise Dead 的时间限制内。
target: You touch a corpse or other remains. For the duration, the target does not decay and cannot become Undead. The spell also effectively extends the time limit for bringing the target back to life, since time spent under its influence does not count against the time limit of spells such as Raise Dead.
note: Preserved decay and Undead prevention plus the resurrection time-limit exclusion and example.

source:
一股长60尺，宽10尺的线状强风以你为起点向你指定的方向吹去。每名位于线状区域内的生物必须成功于一次力量豁免，豁免失败则沿着线状的方向被推离你15尺。在线状区域内结束其回合的生物也必须进行同样的豁免。
任何生物在线状区域内朝更靠近你的方向移动时，其每移动1尺必须花费2尺的移动力。
强风吹散区域内的毒气或蒸汽，并吹熄蜡烛等不受保护的其他类似火焰。而有保护的火焰（比如提灯）则会剧烈摇晃并有50%的概率被吹熄。
你可以在自己随后的回合内用一个附赠动作改变线状风道的方向。
target:
A Line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blows from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you along the Line. A creature that ends its turn in the Line must make the same save.
Any creature moving closer to you within the Line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.
The wind disperses poisonous gas or vapor in the area and extinguishes unprotected flames such as candles. Protected flames, such as those in lanterns, dance wildly and have a 50% chance of being extinguished.
You can use a Bonus Action on your subsequent turns to change the Line's direction.
note: Preserved the immediate and end-of-turn saves, movement ratio, gas dispersal, protected-flame chance, and steering action.

source:
指定施法距离内一件你能看见的人造金属物件（例如一把金属武器，或者一套金属质的重甲或中甲），并使该物件变得炽热。施展该法术时，任何与该物件有物理接触的生物均受到2d8点火焰伤害。直到法术终止前，只要这个物件依然在施法距离内，你都可以在你随后的每个回合以一个附赠动作来再次造成此伤害。
若握持或着装该物件的生物因此受到伤害，则该生物必须通过一次体质豁免，否则如果这个生物只要能丢下该物件，该生物就必须丢下该物件。如果该物件没有被丢下，则直至你的下一回合开始为止，该生物进行攻击检定和属性检定时具有劣势。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d8。
target:
Choose a manufactured metal object you can see within range, such as a metal weapon or a suit of metal Heavy or Medium armor, and make it intensely hot. When you cast the spell, any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 Fire damage. Until the spell ends, you can use a Bonus Action on each of your subsequent turns to deal this damage again, provided the object is still within range.
If a creature holding or wearing the object takes this damage, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can. If it does not drop the object, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the 2024 continued-range requirement, save to avoid dropping, and disadvantage when the object is not dropped.

source:
指定施法距离内一个你能看见的类人生物。该目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则其在法术持续时间内陷入麻痹状态。目标在其每回合结束时可以重新进行这次豁免，豁免成功则终止其身上该法术的效应。
升环施法：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，就可以额外指定一个类人作为目标。
target:
Choose a Humanoid you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is Paralyzed for the duration. It can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell's effect on itself on a success.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can target one additional Humanoid for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the Humanoid limitation, end-of-turn repeated saves, and scaling without adding a target-spacing requirement.

source:
你触碰的一个生物进入隐形状态并维持至法术终止。如果目标进行攻击检定、造成伤害或施展法术，则此法术提前终止。
升环施法：使用三环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比二环高一环，就可以额外指定一个生物作为目标。
target:
A creature you touch becomes Invisible until the spell ends. The spell ends early if the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of level three or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above level two.
note: Preserved all three early-ending triggers, including dealing damage independently of an attack roll.

source:
指定施法距离内一个你能看见的物件。该物件可以是一扇门，一个盒子，一个箱子，一副镣铐，一把挂锁，或是一个其他的通过魔法或普通手段来防止被打开的物件。
被一把普通锁锁住的目标其锁会被解开，被卡死的目标会被松开，被闩住的目标会被打开。如果目标被多把锁锁住，则只有一把锁会被打开。
若你指定的目标被法术秘法锁arcane locks 锁住，则该秘法锁被压制 10 分钟，这段时间内目标可被正常开启和关闭。
施展该法术时，受术目标会发出一声响亮的敲击声，其声响最远 300 尺内都能听见。
target:
Choose an object you can see within range. It can be a door, box, chest, set of manacles, padlock, or another object secured against opening by magical or mundane means.
A target locked with a mundane lock is unlocked, a stuck target is unstuck, and a barred target is unbarred. If the target has multiple locks, only one is unlocked.
If the target is secured with Arcane Lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes, during which the target can be opened and closed normally.
When you cast the spell, a loud knocking sound comes from the target and can be heard as far as 300 feet away.
note: Preserved the complete object examples, one-lock limit, Arcane Lock suppression rather than dispelling, and audible distance.

source:
指定施法距离内你能看见的一个生物或未固定的物件，使其垂直上升至多 20 尺，并在该处维持悬浮直至持续时间结束。该法术可悬浮一个重量至多 500 磅的目标。一个非自愿的生物可以对法术进行一次体质豁免，若成功将避免受其影响。
目标只能通过推或拉一个固定的物件或平面（例如一面墙或者天花板）来进行移动，这种移动方式视为等同于攀爬。你可以在自己回合里将目标的悬浮高度向上或向下改变至多 20 尺：如果你自身就是该法术的目标，则你可以进行上升和下降并将其作为你移动的一部分；如果你不是该法术的目标，则你可以使用魔法动作来移动目标，但目标必须始终处于你的施法距离内。
法术终止时，仍处于空中的目标会缓缓飘落到地面。
target:
Choose a creature or unsecured object you can see within range. It rises vertically up to 20 feet and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target weighing up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature can make a Constitution saving throw, avoiding the effect on a success.
The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface, such as a wall or ceiling; this movement is treated as climbing. On your turn, you can change the target's height up or down by up to 20 feet. If you are the target, you can ascend or descend as part of your movement. Otherwise, you can use a Magic action to move the target, but it must remain within the spell's range.
When the spell ends, a target still aloft floats gently to the ground.
note: Preserved weight and vertical limits, climbing-based self-movement, self-versus-other action costs, and gentle descent.

source:
你点名或描述一个你熟悉的物件。只要该物件与你相距不超过1000尺，你就会感测到该物件的方位。如果该物件正在移动，则你也将知晓其移动的方向。
该法术可定位一个你认识的特定物件，不过你需要曾经在30尺内近距离看到过该物件至少一次；或者它也可定位特定的一类物件（如某种服装、珠宝、家具、工具或武器）中距你最近个体。如果有任意厚度的铅，即使只是薄薄一片铅片阻挡了你与被定位物件间的通路，则该物件也无法被该法术所定位。
target:
Name or describe an object familiar to you. You sense its direction while it is within 1000 feet of you. If it is moving, you also learn the direction of its movement.
The spell can locate a specific object you know, provided you have seen it at least once from within 30 feet. Alternatively, it can locate the nearest object of a particular kind, such as a certain type of clothing, jewelry, furniture, tool, or weapon. The spell cannot locate an object if lead of any thickness, even a thin sheet, blocks the path between you and it.
note: Preserved the familiarity/previous-sighting distinction, nearest-kind alternative, movement direction, and lead barrier.

source: 你将一段信息植入施法距离内的一个物件中，其信息会在满足预设事件时说出。指定一个你能看见且未被另一生物穿着或携带的物件。然后，你可以使用至多10分钟来传达这段不超过25个字的信息。最后再来设定触发法术传达信息的事件。预设的事件发生时，目标物件上出现一张魔法嘴，并用与你相同的声音和音量复述所存储的信息。如果你指定的目标本身有一张嘴或者类似嘴的结构（例如雕像的嘴），则魔法嘴将生成在该嘴结构的位置，使其看起来如同是物件的嘴在说话一样。施展该法术时，你可以让法术在传达过信息后随即终止，或者也可以让法术一直持续并在每次被预设条件触发时进行复述。你所决定的触发条件可以很概括也可以很具体，不过你只能根据目标物件30尺内的视觉或听觉状况来设定条件。例如，你可以命令魔嘴在任何生物移动至物件30尺内时说出信息，或者当其30尺内有银铃响起时说出信息。
target: You implant a message in an object within range, to be spoken when a preset event occurs. Choose an object you can see that is not worn or carried by another creature. You can then take up to 10 minutes to deliver a message of no more than 25 characters. Finally, set the event that will trigger the message. When that event occurs, a magical mouth appears on the object and recites the stored message in your voice and at the same volume. If the target already has a mouth or mouthlike feature, such as the mouth of a statue, the magical mouth appears there, making it look as though the object's mouth is speaking. When you cast the spell, you can have it end after delivering the message, or have it persist and repeat the message whenever the preset condition occurs. Your triggering condition can be as general or specific as you like, but it must be based on visual or audible circumstances within 30 feet of the object. For example, you can command the mouth to speak when any creature moves within 30 feet of the object, or when a silver bell rings within 30 feet of it.
note: The source limits the message by characters, not explicitly words; characters is retained pending language-rule review. Both examples, matching voice/volume, existing-mouth placement, and repeat-versus-once choices are preserved.

source:
你触碰一件非魔法武器。直到法术结束前，它成为魔法武器且在进行攻击检定和伤害掷骰时具有+1 加值。你再次施放该法术时，先前的效应提前结束。
升环施法：使用三至五环的法术位时，此法术的加值增加至+2；使用高于五环的法术位时，此法术的加值增加至+3。
target:
You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, it becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. If you cast this spell again, the previous effect ends early.
At Higher Levels: Using a spell slot of level three through five increases the bonus to +2. Using a slot above level five increases it to +3.
note: Preserved the 2024 recasting end condition and the exact three-through-five and above-five bonus bands.

source:
一支闪烁的绿色箭矢朝一个施法距离内的目标疾速飞去，并炸裂成一滩强酸。对目标进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到4d4点强酸伤害，然后再其下一回合结束时再受到2d4点强酸伤害。若未命中，则箭矢的酸液溅射目标，造成初始伤害一半的伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术伤害（包括初始和后续）增加1d4。
target:
A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts into a splash of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 Acid damage, then takes 2d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid, dealing half the initial damage.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage, both initial and subsequent, increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved separate initial and delayed damage, half-initial-damage miss result, and scaling of both damage rolls.

source:
指定施法距离内一个可见生物，你驱动一道心灵能量的锥刺侵入目标的心智。目标必须进行一次感知豁免检定，失败则会受到3d8点心灵伤害，成功则只受一半伤害。在目标豁免失败时，你在法术结束之前能时刻得知目标所在的位置，只要你们还处于同一个存在位面上。当你拥有目标的位置信息时，目标将不能对你躲藏，并且如果它隐形了，在对抗你时它不能从这个状态中受益。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d8。
target:
Choose a creature you can see within range and drive a spike of psychic energy into its mind. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you also know the target's location at all times until the spell ends, as long as you are on the same plane of existence. While you know its location, the target cannot hide from you and gains no benefit from being Invisible against you.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved failed-save-only tracking, same-plane restriction, and observer-specific hiding/invisibility effects.

source:
三个你自身的幻象分身出现在你所处的空间中。直到法术终止前，分身都会随你移动，并模仿你的动作和位置变换，使人无法追踪判断哪一个是你的真身。
在法术持续时间内，每当一个生物攻击命中你时，为每个剩余分身投掷一个d6，只要有任一d6骰出3或以上，一个分身代你承受本次命中并随之被摧毁。分身无视所有其他的伤害和效应。三个分身都被摧毁时，法术随之结束。
如果一名生物处于目盲状态，或拥有盲视，或拥有真实视觉，则该法术无法影响该生物。
target:
Three illusory duplicates of you appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions and changes of position, making it impossible to track which one is real.
For the duration, whenever a creature hits you with an attack, roll a d6 for each remaining duplicate. If any d6 rolls 3 or higher, one duplicate takes the hit instead of you and is destroyed. The duplicates ignore all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.
The spell has no effect on a creature that is Blinded, has Blindsight, or has Truesight.
note: Preserved the 2024 post-hit d6-per-duplicate resolution, destruction of only one duplicate, and all three observer exceptions.

source:
指定施法距离内一点，一束淡淡的银光照耀在以该点为中心半径5尺、高40尺的柱状区域内。直至法术终止前，柱状区域内处于微光光照。在施展该法术的后续回合内，你能够以一个魔法动作将柱状区域移动至多60尺。柱状区域出现时，每个区域内的生物进行一次体质豁免检定，豁免失败则受到2d10的光耀伤害，且若该生物已变形（例如受法术变形术Polymorph影响），其变回真实形态，且无法在离开柱状区域前变形。豁免成功则仅承受前述伤害的一半。在法术区域进入生物空间、生物进入法术区域或在其内结束回合时，目标生物也需要进行该体质豁免检定。一名生物每回合仅需进行一次该豁免检定。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的伤害就增加1d10。
target:
Choose a point within range. A pale silver beam shines in a Cylinder with a radius of 5 feet and a height of 40 feet centered on that point. The Cylinder is filled with Dim Light until the spell ends. On turns after you cast the spell, you can use a Magic action to move the Cylinder up to 60 feet. When the Cylinder appears, each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d10 Radiant damage and, if it is transformed (such as by Polymorph), returns to its true form and cannot transform again until it leaves the Cylinder. On a successful save, it takes only half the damage. A creature must also make this Constitution saving throw when the spell's area enters its space, when it enters the area, or when it ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.
At Higher Levels: The spell's damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved immediate and all later area triggers, once-per-turn save limit, transformed-creature reversion only on failure, and the 2024 Magic-action movement. Root wording check: both reversion and the transformation restriction are explicitly inside the failed-save clause.

source:
你触及一名自愿生物或者一个未被着装或携带的物件以在其上设置一道幻术。生物获得下述伪装效应，物件则获得下述虚假灵光效应。效应持续至法术结束。如果你持续30日每日均对同一个目标施展此法术，则幻术会的持续时间变为直至被解除。
伪装Mask（生物）。选择一种目标实际生物类型以外的生物类别。法术和其他魔法效应会将目标生物视为属于该生物类型来处理效果。
虚假灵光False Aura（物件）。你改变物件在能够侦测魔法灵光的侦测法术和魔法效应（例如侦测魔法Detect Magic）中呈现的样子。你可以使一个非魔法物件如同具有魔法性、让一个魔法物件如同只是非魔法的，或者改变物件的魔法灵光学派，使其呈现出由你选择的特定魔法学派的灵光。
target:
You touch a willing creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried, placing an illusion on it. A creature gains the Mask effect below, while an object gains the False Aura effect. The effect lasts until the spell ends. If you cast this spell on the same target every day for 30 days, the illusion lasts until dispelled.
Mask (Creature). Choose a creature type other than the target's actual type. Spells and other magical effects treat the target as belonging to that type when resolving their effects.
False Aura (Object). You change how the object appears to detection spells and magical effects that detect magical auras, such as Detect Magic. You can make a nonmagical object seem magical, make a magical object seem nonmagical, or change the school of its magical aura to a particular school of your choice.
note: Preserved the separate creature/object effects and the source's broad magical-effect type treatment; no narrower detection-only restriction was substituted.

source: 你试图向施法距离内你可见的一名生物脑内植入一段幻术。目标进行一次智力豁免。豁免失败时，你创造出一个不大于10尺立方且只能被目标感知到的魅影物件，生物或其他你指定的现象。魅影将持续至法术终止。该魅影包括声音、温度和其他感官因素。目标可以用研究动作进行一次对抗你法术豁免DC的智力（调查）检定来仔细研究这个魅影。检定成功则目标意识到魅影是一道幻术，法术终止。目标受法术影响期间会认定魅影是真实的，并且会合理化任何与其互动产生的不合逻辑的结果。例如，若目标试图走过一座跨越峡谷的魅影桥时从桥上坠落并存活，它仍然会相信该桥是真实存在的，并且会觉得是其他什么东西导致了自己的坠落。若魅影代表着一名危险生物或一处灾害，则受术目标甚至还会受到幻术的直接伤害。在每个你的回合中，若目标在魅影区域内或距其5尺范围内，则上述形态的魅影可以对目标造成2d8点心灵伤害。而此时目标则会感觉该伤害类型与魅影适于造成的一种伤害类型相符。
target: You attempt to plant an illusion in the mind of a creature you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or other phenomenon of your choice that is no larger than a 10-foot Cube and can be perceived only by the target. The phantasm lasts until the spell ends and includes sound, temperature, and other sensory details. The target can use the Study action to examine the phantasm with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. On a success, the target recognizes it as an illusion and the spell ends. While affected, the target treats the phantasm as real and rationalizes any illogical outcomes of interacting with it. For example, if the target tries to cross a phantasmal bridge over a chasm, falls through it, and survives, it still believes the bridge is real and assumes something else caused the fall. If the phantasm represents a dangerous creature or hazard, the target can even take direct damage from it. On each of your turns, such a phantasm can deal 2d8 Psychic damage to the target if it is in the phantasm's area or within 5 feet of it. The target perceives this damage as a type appropriate to the phantasm.
note: Preserved the full bridge example, sensory details, Study-action disproof, damage positioning, and perceived-versus-actual damage type.

source:
在施展法术期间一直位于施法距离内的至多五名生物获得等同于一次短休的增益，并且恢复2d8点生命值。一名生物直到完成一次长休为止不能再次被此法术影响。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，此法术的治疗量就增加1d8。
target:
Up to five creatures that remain within range throughout the casting gain the benefits of a Short Rest and regain 2d8 Hit Points. A creature cannot be affected by this spell again until it finishes a Long Rest.
At Higher Levels: The spell's healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved the 2024 Short Rest benefit, continuous-range requirement, five-target limit, and per-creature Long Rest restriction.

source: 你向施法距离内的一名生物射出一道让人衰弱的能量射线。目标必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免成功，则目标直到你的下个回合开始在下一次攻击掷骰上具有劣势。豁免失败，目标在持续时间内在使用力量属性的D20检定上具有劣势。同样的，在此期间，其所有的伤害掷骰获得1d8的减值。目标在每个其回合结束时可以重复豁免，豁免成功则法术终止。
target: You shoot a ray of weakening energy at a creature within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. On a failed save, it has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests for the duration. During that time, it also has a 1d8 penalty to all its damage rolls. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
note: Preserved both successful-save and failed-save effects, all damage rolls rather than only Strength damage, and repeated saves.

source: 你接触一段绳子。绳的一端会向上升起，直到整条绳索都垂直于地面挂在空中或绳子触及天花板。绳子向上的末端存在一个隐形的3尺×5尺大小的传送门，其通往一个法术持续时间内一直存在的异次元空间。沿着绳子向上攀爬即可进入此空间，绳子也可被拽入空间中或从空间中丢出。空间可容纳至多八名体型不超过中型的生物。攻击，法术和其他效应均无法穿过空间而出入，但空间内的生物可以通过入口看到外面的景象。法术终止时，异次元空间内的一切东西都会掉出来。
target: You touch a length of rope. One end rises until the whole rope hangs vertically above the ground or the rope touches the ceiling. At its upper end is an Invisible portal measuring 3 feet × 5 feet, leading to an extradimensional space that exists for the duration. You can enter the space by climbing up the rope, and the rope can be pulled inside or dropped out. The space can hold up to eight creatures no larger than Medium. Attacks, spells, and other effects cannot pass into or out of the space, but creatures inside can look out through the entrance. When the spell ends, everything in the extradimensional space falls out.
note: Preserved ceiling-limited rope ascent, portal dimensions, rope handling, size/capacity limits, and the passage restriction for all other effects.

source:
你射出三道火焰的射线。你可以将其射向施法距离内的一个或多个目标。每道射线需要你分别进行一次远程法术攻击。若命中，则目标受到2d6点火焰伤害。
升环施法：使用的法术位每比二环高一环，你就能多创造出一道射线。
target:
You fire three rays of flame at one or more targets within range. Make a separate ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage.
At Higher Levels: You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above level two.
note: Preserved three independently rolled rays, flexible target distribution, and additional-ray scaling.
